info.description: Flint's public /v1 API for payments, checkout, invoices, subscriptions, catalog, customers, returns, inventory, money movement, webhooks, and developer operations. Use live keys for production and sandbox-bound test keys for staging or sandbox workflows; keep ordinary secret API keys server-side. The first-party docs playground uses a dedicated sandbox-only sample key exception. A request body can be up to 1 MiB unless an operation documents a lower limit; a larger body returns 413 with the REQUEST_BODY_TOO_LARGE error code.

post.description: Adds up to 500 values, each validated and normalized for the list's item_type. The additions array reports each value's outcome: values already on the list come back as existing, so a batch is safe to resend. Returns 201 when at least one value was added and 200 when none were. Payments see the change from the next attempt.

CheckoutSessionBearer.description: The checkout credential from checkout_auth_token, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. It acts for one checkout session and its order. Accepted only by the operations that list it.

CustomerSessionBearer.description: The customer session secret (`flint_cses_...`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Accepted only by `/v1/me`. Keep it on your server: Flint has no browser credential, and your backend relays the buyer's account calls.

OnboardingSessionBearer.description: Short-lived onboarding token returned by POST /v1/onboarding/verify-email. Onboarding and merchant account sessions are limited to the merchant's default sandbox unless sandbox_id names another sandbox of the same merchant. Refresh stays bound to the launch token's sandbox. Live onboarding requires a live API key created in the dashboard.

AddRiskListItemsRequest.description: Values to add to the risk list. Values are trimmed and compared exactly after item-type normalization for deduplication and membership. card_fingerprint is the 32-character hexadecimal value from PaymentMethod.fingerprint and is lowercased; case_sensitive_string preserves case and Unicode composition. string and email are lowercased, with accents preserved. email requires a bare address. email_domain is lowercased, has one final dot removed, and converts internationalized domains to ASCII. ip_address uses canonical IP form, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 conversion to IPv4. country uses uppercase ISO codes. card_bin preserves 6 through 8 digits, including leading zeros, and matches the full value. customer_id preserves the validated ID.

values.description: Values to add to the risk list, in request order. Values are trimmed and compared exactly after item-type normalization for deduplication and membership. card_fingerprint is the 32-character hexadecimal value from PaymentMethod.fingerprint and is lowercased; case_sensitive_string preserves case and Unicode composition. string and email are lowercased, with accents preserved. email requires a bare address. email_domain is lowercased, has one final dot removed, and converts internationalized domains to ASCII. ip_address uses canonical IP form, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 conversion to IPv4. country uses uppercase ISO codes. card_bin preserves 6 through 8 digits, including leading zeros, and matches the full value. customer_id preserves the validated ID.

items.description: Limited to 512 characters (Unicode code points) before normalization and after normalization.

x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCESS_LINK_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: The resource has no customer, and an access link opens a resource only for its customer. Set customer_id on orders before payment to link their buyers to them and to their returns.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCESS_LINK_MERCHANT_HOSTED: The merchant hosts its own customer account, so Flint has no account page for an access link to open. Show the resource in your own account with a customer session, or set customer_account.mode to flint_hosted.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SETUP_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT: The stored account-provisioning configuration is not supported by this application release. Contact Flint support to repair the account setup configuration before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SETUP_REPAIR_REQUIRED: The merchant's account setup needs repair. Contact Flint support to repair the account setup before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE: The merchant's account setup is unavailable. Complete account setup or contact Flint support before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACH_TRANSACTION_PURPOSE_UNRESOLVED: ACH debit cannot be offered because the order's line items do not show whether the purchase is for goods or services. Include a physical or digital product line item, or use service products for every line item that is not a fee. Otherwise collect payment without ACH debit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: The resource's current state does not allow this action. Branch on details[0].reason; fall back to current_status for unknown reasons and use supported_actions when present.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_DEMO_SESSION_EXISTS: An active demo session already exists. Use the active demo session or end it before creating another.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_LINE_ITEM_SOURCE_CHANGE: An active payment link cannot add, remove, or change the key or catalog source of its line items. Keep every existing payment_link_line_item_id with its key, variant_id, and bundle_id, or set status to inactive before replacing line items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_OPTION_SELECTOR_COLLAPSE: The option replacement would make active variant selections indistinguishable. Keep enough active options and values to distinguish every active variant.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AFFIRM_REFUND_RETRY_NOT_ALLOWED: A failed provider refund already exists for this Affirm payment. Do not create a new provider refund. Use an alternative reimbursement and reconcile the failed Refund.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ALREADY_EXISTS: A resource already occupies the requested key or slot. Use details[0].current_resource, or choose another key or slot.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The manual payment is larger than the invoice's collectible balance. Retrieve the invoice and record an amount_money no greater than its collectible balance.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE: The refund amount is more than what remains refundable on the order, payment, line item, or charge. Reduce the amount named by param. For a line item or charge, details[0].maximum_money gives the remaining refundable amount and currency; otherwise read the order's settlement amounts. To refund the full remainder, set refund_type to full and remove amount_money, line_items, charges, tax_breakdown_refunds, and tender_allocations.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The payment processor's amount for this payment intent no longer matches Flint's record. Do not retry the confirmation. Contact support with the request_id and the payment intent ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_NOT_ADJUSTABLE: unit_price_overrides names a line item whose price buyers cannot change. Remove the line item from unit_price_overrides.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_ALREADY_REVOKED: The API key is already revoked. Retrieve the API key to confirm its status. Revocation is permanent; create a new key if you need an active credential.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_CHANGED: The API key changed before the update or revocation could be applied. Retrieve the API key, review its current state, and retry the action if it still applies.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_VERSION_RETIRED: The requested API version has retired. Set Flint-Version to a supported version listed in the error details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Authentication is required to complete this request. Complete the authentication described by the error message and next_actions before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_PAYOUT_NOT_CANCELABLE: An automatic payout cannot be canceled. Read the payout to check its status. Automatic payouts cannot be canceled through this operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_PROMOTIONS_DISABLED: Automatic promotions are turned off in the merchant's promotion settings. Set promotions.automatic_enabled to true with PATCH /v1/settings first, or stop turning on automatic promotions in the field identified by param.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_CONNECTION_REQUIRED: Automatic tax needs an active tax connection for the account. Connect automatic tax in the dashboard's tax settings, use external tax, or turn tax off.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_ORIGIN_ADDRESS_REQUIRED: A location the order ships or is picked up from has no country or postal code. Add a country and postal code to the location named in the message, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_UNAVAILABLE: Automatic tax is temporarily unavailable for this account. Use external tax for this order or contact Flint support.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BILLING_INTERVAL_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store doesn't offer other billing intervals for this subscription. Change it only when the subscription's billing_interval_options lists more than one option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_COMPONENT_PRODUCT_NOT_ACTIVE: A bundle component references a product that is not active. Use a variant whose parent product is active, or keep the bundle inactive.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_COMPONENT_VARIANT_NOT_ACTIVE: A bundle component references a variant that is not active. Use an active variant, or keep the bundle inactive.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_NOT_SELLABLE: The bundle is inactive or its component configuration cannot be sold. Choose an active, sellable bundle or correct its component configuration before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_IMMEDIATELY_NOT_ALLOWED: The store ends a buyer's cancellation when the billing period ends. Read buyer_actions.cancel.timing and omit cancel_immediately when timing is end_of_period.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPABILITIES_IMMUTABLE: The requested capabilities differ from the ones account setup already started with. Omit requested_capabilities, or send the same capabilities as the earlier request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPABILITY_NOT_REQUESTED: The operation needs a capability that has not been requested for this merchant account. Check readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant. For accept_ach_debit_payments, add ach_debit to the checkout or invoice payment options with PATCH /v1/settings. For other capabilities, contact Flint support.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPTURE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURABLE: The requested capture exceeds the authorization's current capturable amount. Use an amount no greater than capturable_money, or omit amount_money to capture the available authorization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_INVENTORY_RELATIONSHIP_INVALID: The catalog item's inventory configuration is inconsistent. Correct the catalog item's inventory relationship before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_LINE_ITEM_CURRENCY_CHANGED: The catalog item's currency no longer matches the order line item. Use a catalog item in the order's currency, or create a new order in the catalog item's current currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_LINE_ITEM_SOURCE_CHANGED: The order line item's catalog source no longer matches the current variant. Remove the line item and add the current variant to the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CREDENTIAL_CHANGED: Checkout authentication was rotated before payment work became durable. Refresh the checkout session through its owning invoice or checkout entry point, then resume the same payment attempt if it remains available.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CUSTOMER_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED: The checkout already acts for a customer, so it needs no code. Save or pay with that customer's cards without a code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CUSTOMER_CHANGED: The order's customer is not the customer this checkout session was created for. Create a new checkout session for the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_CURRENT_CHANGED: The session named by replace_checkout_session_id is no longer the order's current open session. Refresh the session identified by current_checkout_session_id and blocking_resources before retrying the replacement.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_EXPIRED: The checkout session closed, so it cannot be used for this request. Create a new checkout session for the order and continue through it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_MODIFIERS_READ_ONLY: This checkout session cannot modify line item modifiers. Inspect reason: existing_order_checkout uses the existing Order, invoice_finalized uses a finalized Invoice, and subscription_terms_locked uses locked subscription terms. Update the source resource when its state allows changes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_NOT_OPEN: The checkout session is no longer open. Read the session and choose an action its current status allows.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_SCOPE_MISMATCH: The checkout credential cannot use this mode or checkout session. Use the credential issued for this checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SPLIT_PAYMENT_UNSUPPORTED: Hosted checkout collects an order with one payment method, and the order has more than one unpaid payment leg. Cancel each leg in payment_intent_ids with POST /v1/payment-intents/{payment_intent_id}/cancel, then create the session again so hosted checkout collects the balance in one payment. To take a split payment, collect it in your own payment UI, for example under an embedded checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SURFACE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: A payment is in progress on this checkout, so its surface can't change. Finish or cancel the payment on existing_checkout_session_id, or request the session's current surface.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_TAX_CALCULATION_LIMIT_REACHED: The checkout session reached its tax calculation limit. Start a new checkout session or contact the merchant before calculating tax again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: The write lost internal contention while the caller's basis was still current. Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_ALREADY_USED: The confirmation token was already used for a different payment intent. Create a new confirmation token for this payment intent and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_EXPIRED: The confirmation token has expired. Create a new confirmation token and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.COUNTRY_IMMUTABLE: The country differs from the one account setup already started with. Omit country, or send the same country as the earlier request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_ALLOCATION_ALREADY_REVERSED: The credit note allocation was already reversed. Read the allocation to confirm its reversed_at value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The allocation exceeds an available balance. Allocate no more than the credit note's available_money and the invoice's outstanding amount. When required_money is present, the invoice must keep the order's unpaid tip outstanding: allocate up to that limit, collect the remaining balance, then refund the rest of the note once the invoice is paid.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CREDITABLE: The correction exceeds the invoice line's remaining creditable value. Reduce the correction amount or quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_ISSUE_IN_PROGRESS: Another credit note is being issued for this merchant. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key after the current issue finishes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_NOT_DRAFT: Only draft credit notes can be changed. Create a new draft credit note for another correction.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_NOT_ISSUED: The credit note is not issued. Check current_status. Issue a draft before allocating it, refunding it, or downloading its PDF. Only issued notes can be voided, and void notes cannot be allocated or refunded.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_REFUND_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The refund exceeds the available credit. Use an amount no greater than the credit note available_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_ALREADY_APPROVED: The customer's deletion has already been approved. Retrieve the latest deletion request to check its status.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_BLOCKED: The customer still has subscriptions or saved payment methods that could remain operational after account deletion. Cancel every non-canceled subscription and remove every saved payment method, then retry approval.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_PROCESSING: The customer is being deleted or was deleted and can't be changed. Read the customer's status. Use a different active customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_REQUEST_NOT_PENDING: The deletion request's status does not allow this decision. Retrieve the deletion request. A failed request can only be approved again; repeat an applied decision only to retrieve its result.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_STATE_CHANGED: The customer changed while the deletion request was being resolved. Retrieve the deletion request and try again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_EMAIL_BUYER_MANAGED: this customer's email is their sign-in for your store's Flint-hosted account, so only the customer can change it Create a customer session for this customer with POST /v1/customer-sessions, then create the change with POST /v1/me/email-change-requests and the new email. The customer confirms it with the codes Flint emails them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_EMAIL_REQUIRED: The customer has no email address, so there are no email preferences to read or change. Add an email to the customer, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_TERM_UNAVAILABLE: The invoice has no customer default payment term to use. Attach a customer with a default invoice payment term, or choose another payment_due.type.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: The verification is already confirmed. Link the purchases with this verification.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: The verification has no confirmation attempts left. Request a new verification code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_EMAIL_CHANGED: The customer's email changed after verification. Request a code for the customer's current email.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED: The customer verification expired. Create a new customer verification and confirm its code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_LIMIT_REACHED: The checkout has requested as many codes of this channel as it can: 5 emailed codes, or 6 texted-code requests. After a texted-code request, send the code by email instead; otherwise continue without saved details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_CONFIRMED: The customer verification has not been confirmed. Confirm the Flint-sent code before linking guest purchases.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_OFFERED: This checkout does not offer saved payment details. Read the checkout session and request a code only when save_payment_method_requires_verification is true.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_SENT: Flint sent no code for a use_saved_payment_methods request with channel auto, the default: the email has no saved details at this merchant, a cap on codes was reached, or codes can't be sent right now. Show nothing about saved details, and let the buyer pay without them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE: Flint can't text a code for this checkout: the email has no details saved with a mobile phone number at this merchant, a cap on texts was reached, or texts can't be sent right now. Offer the emailed code instead, or continue without saved details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_USED: The customer verification was already redeemed. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key, or create and confirm a new verification.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED: The customer account hostname's payment method domain is not ready for Apple Pay and Google Pay in this environment. Flint registers the hostname as a payment method domain when you create the custom domain. Find it with GET /v1/payment-method-domains and read validation_status and payment_options: unavailable means Flint couldn't read a wallet's status, for example while the environment's payment account isn't ready, and action_required means the registration or one of its wallets isn't active. Then retry POST /v1/custom-domains with the same hostname, which checks the registration again; if you send an idempotency key, use a new one. Contact support with the request_id if the error persists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Custom domains are not active for this account. Activate custom domains, then set the custom domain again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_UNAVAILABLE: The custom domain is in use by another account, as the other custom hostname, or in another environment. Use a different hostname, or remove it where it is set and then set it again. If another account used it, verify ownership after that account removes it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_ENVIRONMENT_REQUIRED: The merchant has no default live environment configured. Configure a default live merchant environment before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD_CONFLICT: The default payment method cannot be set and cleared in the same request. Send default_payment_method_id as a payment method ID to set it, or null to clear it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATIONS_MANAGED_EXTE: Another system manages the default payout destinations. Update the default destinations through the system that manages them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_INVALID: The default payout destination cannot receive this payout. Choose an eligible payout destination before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_REPLACEMENT_R: Removing this default payout destination requires a replacement. Choose another default payout destination before removing this one.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_REQUIRED: No default payout destination is configured. Configure a default payout destination before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_SANDBOX_CANNOT_BE_ARCHIVED: The default sandbox cannot be archived. The default sandbox cannot be archived. Use a separate sandbox for disposable test data.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_SANDBOX_CANNOT_BE_RESET: The default sandbox cannot be reset. Choose a sandbox that supports reset.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_CALCULATION_EXPIRED: The calculation behind the delivery selection expired before payment began. Create a new delivery quote, select a current option, and retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_COMMERCE_TREATMENT_UNSUPPORTED: The selected delivery obligations require incompatible commerce treatment. Change the delivery method or obligation configuration so the selected quantities share compatible tax, currency, and destination treatment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DEPENDENCY_REVOKED: A pinned delivery dependency was revoked and can no longer authorize a new quote or selection. Publish or select a replacement configuration revision, then create a new quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_CONTROLLED_BY_SELEC: The current delivery selection controls the order's delivery destination. Change or clear the delivery selection instead of updating delivery_destination directly.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_FROZEN: The order's delivery destination can no longer be changed. Read the current order and use fulfillment recipient corrections for execution changes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_ELIGIBILITY_CONTEXT_CHANGED: The delivery eligibility context changed. Request a new delivery quote and retry. Request a new delivery quote and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_REUSED: The delivery external reference is already bound to another selection. Reuse the existing selection or submit a new external reference.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_GROUPING_UNSUPPORTED: The delivery obligations cannot form a valid set of buyer choices. Change the assigned delivery profiles, origin policies, or splitting rules before creating another quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_OPTION_ALREADY_SELECTED: The selected delivery option belongs to another selection. Read the current selection, then retry with its ID as the compare-and-swap value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_OPTION_EXPIRED: The selected delivery option or its guarantee expired. Create a new delivery quote and select a current option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PICKUP_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED: The current delivery selection changed during the pickup search. Read the current delivery selection and retry with its ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PICKUP_LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: The requested pickup location is not available for the configured delivery methods. Choose a pickup location from the configured collection and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PREVIEW_REQUIRES_CHECKOUT: The requested preview depends on checkout-only state. Create or update a checkout session, then request a checkout delivery quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_BASIS_INVALID: The pending quote no longer matches the supplied checkout inputs. Create a new quote from the current checkout inputs.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_EXPIRED: The delivery quote or one of its options expired. Create a new delivery quote and select a current option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_INCOMPLETE: The delivery quote still requires caller input or rates. Supply every input or caller-supplied method result requested by the pending quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_INPUT_CHANGED: The selected destination conflicts with address facts used by the quote. Create a new delivery quote using the selected destination.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_REVOKED: The delivery quote was revoked. Create a new quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_STALE: The quote no longer matches the current checkout authority. Create a new delivery quote and retry the selection.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_RATE_CALLBACK_SECRET_ROTATION_O: The delivery rate callback's previous signing key is still valid from an earlier rotation. Retry after previous_key_expires_at. If the current key leaked, revoke it, then rotate.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_REQUOTE_REQUIRED: The delivery quote or selection must be replaced. Create a new delivery quote, select an option, and resend with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT: Another write changed the delivery resource while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the delivery resource again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_CHANGED: The current delivery selection changed after the request basis was read. Read the effective selection, create a replacement-basis quote, and retry with its exact selection ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_EXPIRED: The delivery selection expired before payment began. Create a new delivery quote, select a current option, and retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_NOT_MUTABLE_AFTER_PAY: The delivery selection can no longer be changed after payment begins. Read the current order and continue with its committed delivery selection.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_REPLACEMENT_LIMIT_REA: This checkout reached its protected delivery selection history limit. Finish or restart the checkout. Terminal private payloads become eligible for redaction after their retention period.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_STATE_CONFLICT: The delivery resource is not in a state that allows the operation. Read the current resource and choose an operation valid for its lifecycle state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_UPDATE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store does not allow buyers to change subscription delivery. Ask the store to update the preference or enable customer_account.buyer_capabilities.can_update_delivery.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_WINDOW_EXPIRED: The selected delivery window expired. Create a new delivery quote and select a current window.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEMO_SESSION_NOT_CURRENT: demo_session_id is not this client's current demo session. Send the current session's demo_session_id, which ACTIVE_DEMO_SESSION_EXISTS returns, or create a demo session when none is active.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEMO_SESSION_SECRET_REPLAY_EXPIRED: The demo session secret is no longer available for replay. Create a new demo session to obtain a new secret.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEVICE_ARCHIVED: The device is archived and cannot be changed. Use the ID of an active device.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEVICE_LOCATION_MISMATCH: The device does not belong to the given location. Send a device_id assigned to location_id, or change location_id to the device's location.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DISCOUNT_NOT_REMOVABLE: The discount comes from an automatic promotion, which applies while the order qualifies. Make the promotion inactive to stop applying it. Merchant discounts and code discounts can still be removed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_CODE: Another resource already uses this code. Use the existing resource or send a different code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_ALREADY_LINKED: The email address is already linked. Use the linked account or choose another email address.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_CHANGE_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: The email change was already confirmed. Sign the buyer in again with the new email.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_CHANGE_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: The email change has no confirmation attempts left. Request a new email change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_CHANGE_CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED: The email change confirmation window expired. Request a new email change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_CHANGE_SUPERSEDED: A newer email change replaced this request. Use the codes from the latest email change request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_PREFERENCE_LINK_INVALID: The email preference link is invalid or belongs to another merchant environment. Use the token from the buyer's latest email with the merchant key for that environment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EVENT_SOLD_OUT: The event has no tickets left. Stop offering the event, or raise event_config.max_total_quantity on the payment link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EVENT_TICKETS_INSUFFICIENT: The event has fewer tickets left than this order requests. Request no more than available_quantity tickets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_PAID_ORDER_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED: The billing account reached its monthly limit for externally recorded paid orders. Request a higher allowance from Flint, or record the payment after the monthly limit resets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR: A required external service failed. Retry the same request with exponential backoff and jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FILE_NOT_UPLOADED: The file bytes have not arrived. PUT the bytes to upload.url before upload.expires_at, then complete the file.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FLAT_TAX_PAYMENT_ATTRIBUTION_UNAVAILABLE: The flat tax is not fully attributable to refundable payment settlements. For a flat tax split across payments, refund by order_id instead of payment_intent_id. Otherwise, check the order's remaining refundable tax and payment amounts.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FLAT_TAX_REFUND_STATE_INVALID: Stored flat-tax refund lineage is inconsistent with whole-or-nothing reversal. Contact support with the request ID so Flint can repair the order's refund records
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FORBIDDEN: The credential does not permit this request. Use a credential authorized for this operation. Read details[0].reason.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_ACTIVE_SHIPMENT_EXECUTION: A shipment fulfillment cannot release its quantity while it has a shipment that is not voided. Void the fulfillment's shipments first, or fail it with release_quantity set to false.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This fulfillment requires explicit merchant approval before work begins. Accept the fulfillment, then advance it into preparation, movement, or completion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_CHANGED: Another write changed the fulfillment while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the fulfillment again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETED: The fulfillment is completed. Read the fulfillment and choose an action its status allows.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETED_DETAILS_REPLACEMEN: A completed fulfillment cannot replace these details. Keep the completed fulfillment details and create another fulfillment if needed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETION_TIMESTAMP_REQUIRE: Completion timestamps can be recorded only on a completed fulfillment. Complete the fulfillment with the complete action, then correct its completion timestamp with PATCH if needed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_CONFIGURATION_ACTION_REQUIRE: The catalog item has no active fulfillment profile with a usable revision. Assign an active fulfillment profile with a usable current revision to the catalog item before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_EVENT_DEDUPE_CONFLICT: An event with this external_system and external_event_id already exists with different details. Resend the original event unchanged, or use a new external_event_id for a different event.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_EVENT_SUBJECT_INVALID: Flint could not resolve the fulfillment event's subject. Contact support with the request_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_INACTIVE: The fulfillment is canceled, failed, or marked no-show, so it cannot take this change. Use an active fulfillment, or create a new fulfillment for the items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_METHOD_ASSIGNMENT_UNSATISFIA: The assigned delivery methods cannot fulfill every item that requires delivery. Assign, for each item, a method whose type is in the item's delivery profile allowed_types: in delivery_method_ids on the checkout session or payment link, or in settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids, which payment links without methods and invoice checkouts use.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE: A delivery method in the request, a checkout, a payment link, or the checkout default, or a zone, location set, or rate callback it uses, is missing or not active. Use IDs of active delivery methods whose zones, location sets, and rate callbacks are active. When present, blocking_resources names the resource to replace or activate.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_PROFILE_REVISION_UNUSABLE: The fulfillment profile revision cannot fulfill this catalog item. Correct the fulfillment profile revision described in the error response before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE: The delivery profile is not available. Use an active delivery profile in the same environment, or omit delivery_profile_id when the catalog default applies.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE: A fulfillment line item quantity is more than the quantity left to fulfill. Send a quantity no greater than the line item's unfulfilled quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_LINE_ITEM: The line item quantity would be less than the quantity in its active fulfillments. Keep quantity at or above the quantity in active fulfillments, or cancel those fulfillments first.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: This checkout requires a delivery selection before payment can begin. Create a current delivery quote, select one option for every choice group, then retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SHIPMENT_NOT_VOIDABLE: The shipment is past the packed stage and cannot be voided. Void a shipment only while it is created or packed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_STATUS_CONFLICT: The fulfillment, shipment, or package changed while this request was being saved. Read the current resource and retry the change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_ALLOCATION_CHANGED: The gift card authorization or allocation changed before payment. Refresh the order, apply the current code when required, and accept the new allocation before payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_BUYER_EMAIL_REQUIRED: gift card purchases need the buyer's email for purchase limits Use a customer that has an email, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED: A gift card challenge is required after repeated failed codes. Show the challenge from remediation.next_actions to the buyer, then retry the same request with its proof in Flint-Gift-Card-Challenge. If there is no next action, launch the checkout session with page_origin.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_FUNDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The requested gift card funding exceeds a funding or balance limit. Send a smaller amount, wait for the limit to reset at the reported time, or split the value across cards.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_INSUFFICIENT_VALUE: The gift card has insufficient available value for the requested allocation. Refresh the balance and accept a new allocation before payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_CONFLICT: The gift card purchase cannot be funded under its original terms or funding limits. Keep the original buyer and offer, resolve any existing payment attempt, and check the buyer funding limit before starting another payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The gift card purchase exceeds a daily purchase limit. Wait until the next UTC day before starting a new purchase attempt.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_REFUND_CONFLICT: The original gift card purchase value is unavailable for this cash refund. Check the original funding load and pending refunds. Refund only eligible unspent value and resolve any reserved or spent value before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_REFUND_DESTINATION_REQUIRED: The original gift card cannot accept the full refund within its lifecycle and balance cap. Set destination new_gift_card for that gift card allocation and retry with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_STATE_CONFLICT: The gift card operation conflicts with a lifecycle or provenance constraint. Retrieve the current resource and resolve its stated constraint before submitting a new operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_PROGRESS: A request with the same idempotency key is still in progress. Retry with the same idempotency key using exponential backoff with jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: The idempotency key was reused with a different request body. Use the original request body with this idempotency key, or generate a new idempotency key for a new operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Flint cannot safely recover the original operation's outcome. Read the resource or list the route's results to confirm whether the original operation took effect. Do not switch keys or resend as a new operation until you have confirmed it had no effect. Contact support with the request_id if the outcome cannot be determined.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: fresh identity verification is required Verify your identity again and obtain a new session token, then retry the original request. Keep the same Idempotency-Key if one was sent.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_ASSET_NOT_ATTACHABLE: The image is incomplete, expired, or no longer attachable. Complete the file, or upload a new one if it expired; GET /v1/files/{file_id} shows which. For a Flint url past its reuse window, send the original source_url.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_EXPIRED: The prior image ingestion expired and its reserved storage was cleaned up. Retry the request with a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_IN_PROGRESS: The same image ingestion step is still running. Retry with the same idempotency key and request body using exponential backoff with jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_RESTART_REQUIRED: The prior image ingestion attempt ended and cannot be resumed. Wait briefly for cleanup, then start a new ingestion with a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_NOT_ATTACHABLE: The image cannot be attached to this resource. Use an attachable image returned for the same merchant and environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_OWNER_NOT_MUTABLE: The resource no longer accepts image changes. Retrieve the resource and update images only while the resource is mutable.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_PROCESSING_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: Image processing capacity is temporarily exhausted. Retry with exponential backoff. If remediation says to start a new ingestion, use a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_PROCESSING_FAILED: The image could not be decoded or processed safely. Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key. If the ingestion requires a restart, follow the reason-specific remediation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Image processing exceeded its deadline. Retry with exponential backoff and a new idempotency key when remediation says to start a new ingestion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_REVISION_MISMATCH: The image revision differs from the request's revision. Read the image again and rebuild the request using its current revision.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_SOURCE_TIMEOUT: The source host did not return the image before the fetch deadline. Retry with exponential backoff and a new idempotency key when remediation says to start a new ingestion, or use a more reliable source host.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The source host was temporarily unavailable. Retry with exponential backoff and a new idempotency key when remediation says to start a new ingestion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The merchant's stored image bytes have reached the configured quota. Remove unused image attachments or wait until ready unattached images expire, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INITIAL_API_KEY_ALREADY_CREATED: The initial API key has already been created. Use the existing key or create another key through the authenticated API key routes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INSTANT_PAYOUTS_UNAVAILABLE: Instant payouts are not available. Create a standard payout instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_BALANCE: No single balance source covers the requested payout amount. Each payout draws from one source; details[0].available_by_source_type lists what each source has available. Create one payout per source, each within that source's available amount, or wait for more funds.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: The API key is missing a required scope. Create or use an API key with the required scope, then retry the request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: Flint returned an internal server error. Retry with exponential backoff. Contact support with the request_id if the error persists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CREDENTIAL: The credential cannot authenticate this request. Send a valid credential supported by this endpoint. Read details[0].reason.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_LATE_FEE_AMOUNT: The calculated late fee is zero or exceeds the supported balance. Review the frozen policy and current principal balance.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MERCHANT_SELECTION: The requested merchant is unavailable to this developer identity. Retry with a merchant_id from selectable_merchants.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_STATUS: The order cannot be changed in its current status. Read the order and retry only while its status permits this change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_REQUEST: One or more request inputs are invalid. Correct each input named by details[].param as its message says, then send the request again with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: The resource cannot move to the requested status from its current status. For example, only an open checkout session can be closed. Retrieve the resource and continue from its current status.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_VALUE: A field's value is invalid. Correct the field named by param as the message describes, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_COUNT_INCOMPLETE: The inventory count has lines without saved observations. Save an observation for every inventory item before applying the count.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT: Current eligible inventory cannot satisfy the complete demand. Change demand, replenish stock, or change the routing source before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_ITEM_INACTIVE: The inventory item is not active, so it cannot be assigned to a variant. Activate the inventory item, or assign another active inventory item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: The inventory item does not accept new sale or routing use. Activate the item or use another active inventory item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_LOCATION_ALLOCATION_DISABLED: The Location has inventory_allocation_enabled set to false. Set inventory_allocation_enabled to true for the Location or choose another Location.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_LOCATION_INELIGIBLE: The Location cannot supply this inventory demand. Inspect eligibility_reason, then change the routing source, configure the Location, or replenish inventory before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: The allocation policy is inactive or archived. Activate the policy or choose another active allocation policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_QUANTITY_CONFLICT: The requested reservation or transfer transition conflicts with its current cumulative quantities. Read the reservation or transfer lines and submit cumulative targets within their eligible quantities.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_RECEIPT_CONFLICT: The inventory receipt conflicts with current inventory lineage. Read the linked consumed quantities and retry with a valid remaining return quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_ROUTING_LOCATION_LIMIT_EXCEEDE: The demand requires more Locations than the allocation policy allows. Reduce demand, replenish inventory, or increase the policy's maximum_locations_per_assignment and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_SHORTAGE: The requested committed quantity is not protected by physical stock. Replenish, release, cancel, or explicitly reallocate the affected claim.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_SOURCE_SEQUENCE_CHANGED: The physical observation sequence is stale or conflicting. Read the accepted source sequence and submit a strictly newer absolute observation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_TRANSFER_LINE_CONFLICT: The requested line change conflicts with the transfer's current quantities or lines. Read the current transfer lines and submit a change compatible with their quantities.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE: Stock could not be held for this order's tracked line items. Check availability for the order's routing source, then replenish, widen the allocation policy, or reduce the quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_AUTOPAY_PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED: Automatic invoice collection has no saved card to charge. Set collection.payment_method_id or configure a default card for the customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_BALANCE_CHANGED: The invoice balance changed after the payment request was prepared. Refresh the invoice and rebuild the payment selection from its current collectible balance.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_CHECKOUT_REPLACEMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: Invoice-owned checkout sessions cannot be replaced through generic checkout creation. Manage checkout through the invoice listed in blocking_resources using POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/checkout-session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_COLLECTION_BLOCKED: Invoice collection is blocked until inventory is available. Resolve the inventory block, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_COLLECTION_CHANGED: The invoice collection state changed after the request was prepared. Refresh the invoice, then rebuild the request from its current state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_COLLECTION_MODE_UNSUPPORTED: The invoice collection mode does not support this payment flow. Use hosted checkout for buyer_initiated invoices or POST /collect for automatic invoices.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_ISSUE_IN_PROGRESS: Invoice issue state changed before the request could complete. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LATE_FEE_NOT_COLLECTIBLE: The invoice has no eligible balance for this action. Use an open or partially paid invoice with unpaid principal for assessment or an unpaid fee for waiver.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LATE_FEE_NOT_DUE: The late fee grace period has not elapsed. Wait until the invoice due date and frozen grace period have passed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LATE_FEE_POLICY_REQUIRED: The invoice has no frozen late fee policy. Assess fees only on invoices issued with a late fee policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LINK_UNAVAILABLE: The invoice has no active public link, so hosted collection or link delivery cannot proceed. Regenerate the invoice public link, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LOCKED_ORDER_FINANCIALS: An active invoice owns the order's financial fields and collects its balance. Collect through the invoice listed in blocking_resources: issue it if it is a draft, then send the buyer to its public_url or call POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/checkout-session. To edit the order or collect it another way, void the invoice first.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_COLLECTIBLE: The invoice is not open or partially paid with a balance remaining. Collect only open or partially_paid invoices with a positive outstanding_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_CREDITABLE: The invoice cannot receive a credit note in its current state. Use an issued invoice that has not been voided.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_DRAFT: The invoice is no longer a draft. After an invoice is issued, only reminders_paused can be changed. Read the current invoice. To change it after issue, send only reminders_paused, or correct it with a credit note.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_ISSUED: The invoice has not been issued and has no public link. Issue the invoice before managing its public link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_MARKABLE_UNCOLLECTIBLE: The invoice cannot be marked uncollectible in its current state. Use an open or partially_paid invoice with a positive outstanding balance and no active payment attempt.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_REVERSIBLE: The invoice payment cannot be reversed. Check the payment and invoice state before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_VOIDABLE: The invoice cannot be voided in its current state. Void only an unpaid draft or open invoice.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_ALREADY_SETTLED: The invoice payment settled before cancellation completed. Read the settled attempt and current invoice.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_ACTIVE: An invoice payment attempt is open. Wait for it to finish or cancel it before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_NOT_APPLIED: The invoice is paid, but the selected payment intent has not been applied to it yet. Wait for invoice payment processing to finish, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_PROCESSING: An invoice payment attempt is processing. Wait for it to settle, fail, or be canceled before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_RESOLVING: Invoice payment work is still resolving, so competing collection or mutation cannot proceed yet. Wait for the payment resources listed in blocking_resources to finish, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_TERM_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The payment term's fixed late fee uses a different currency than the invoice. Choose a payment term whose fixed late fee uses the invoice currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_TERM_UNAVAILABLE: The selected invoice payment term is not active for this merchant environment. Choose an active invoice payment term and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_REMINDER_CHANGED: The invoice changed while the reminder was being prepared. Retry the reminder request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_SCHEDULE_ENTRY_NOT_COLLECTIBLE: The invoice has no collectible schedule entry, or the selected entry is not the next one due. Wait until the next entry is due and has an outstanding balance, then collect it. Omit invoice_schedule_entry_id if the invoice has no schedule.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_TAX_SNAPSHOT_MISSING: The invoice has no frozen automatic tax calculation to collect against. Void the invoice, then create and issue a new invoice for the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_TAX_SNAPSHOT_STALE: The order's tax or totals changed after the invoice was issued. Void the invoice, then create and issue a new invoice for the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ITEMS_REQUIRED: The item collection is empty or missing. Provide at least one item in line_items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A value is outside the bound the resource's current state allows. Send a value within the bound in details for the input named by param.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LIMIT_REACHED: A count prevents another request of this kind. Follow the reason to lower the count, wait for its reset, or use another resource.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_REFUND: The line item refund quantity is more than the line's remaining refundable quantity. Read the line item's refunded_quantity and refund no more than the remaining units.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LIST_RESERVED: This list is reserved. Use a list that this operation can change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LOCATION_NOT_ACTIVE: The Location is not active for a new dependency or claim. Activate the Location or choose another active Location.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: The Location is not active in this environment. Use the ID of an active Location, or activate the Location before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MAX_COMPLETIONS_BELOW_COMPLETED: max_completions is lower than the link's completed_count. Set max_completions to at least completed_count, or send null for no limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MAX_TOTAL_QUANTITY_BELOW_SOLD: event_config.max_total_quantity is lower than the tickets already sold or held by payments in progress. Set event_config.max_total_quantity to at least the event's sold and held tickets, or send null for no ticket limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED: The merchant account URL is not on an active verified payment method domain or one of its subdomains. Flint registers the URL's hostname as a payment method domain when you save it. Read it with GET /v1/payment-method-domains, run its check again with PATCH status active once the hostname serves your site, then save merchant_account_url again; if you send an idempotency key, use a new one.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_NOT_READY: The merchant payment account is not ready for domain registration. Complete merchant payment onboarding in the selected environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_ACCOUNT_SETUP_R: The merchant's account setup needs repair before an account session can be created. Contact Flint support to repair account setup before creating another account session.
The merchant must complete account setup before creating an account session. Complete account setup through the onboarding API, then create an account session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_ACCOUNT_SETUP_U: The merchant's account setup is unavailable for account sessions. Contact Flint support to restore account setup before creating an account session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_CONTROLLER_MISM: The merchant's account controller does not support this account session. Use an account session supported by the merchant account controller.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_INELIGIBLE: The merchant is not eligible for this account session. Retrieve the merchant to check its account session eligibility and requirements.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_PROVIDER_GRANT_: The provider issued an account session grant that does not match Flint's request. Contact Flint support with the request_id before creating another account session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_TARGETED_REMEDI: Targeted remediation is unavailable for one or more requested requirement codes. Retrieve the merchant's current requirements and use requirement codes that support targeted remediation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_UNMAPPABLE_REQU: The requirement code cannot be targeted in an account session. Use an available targeted_requirements value from the merchant's current requirements.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_BILLING_SUSPENDED: Payment processing is suspended because the merchant billing balance is past due. Processing resumes automatically once the merchant's past-due Flint balance is paid. The merchant can see what it owes under Billing in the Flint Dashboard and contact Flint support to pay.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_NOT_READY: The merchant must complete a readiness step before this operation. Follow the reason to complete onboarding, resolve requirements, or contact Flint support.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ONBOARDING_REQUIRED: The merchant must complete onboarding. Complete merchant onboarding before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_PROCESSING_RESTRICTED: The merchant's payment account is restricted and cannot accept payments. Retrieve the merchant to find the required remediation, resolve it, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: A merchant must be selected before creating an onboarding session. Retry with a merchant_id from selectable_merchants.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_UNDER_REVIEW: Flint paused payment processing for this merchant account while it completes a review. Processing resumes when Flint completes the review. The merchant can contact Flint support for details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The route exists, but does not support the requested HTTP method. Use one of the methods supported by the route, as listed in the Allow header.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE: A referenced modifier group was archived before the modifier set was saved. Retrieve the modifier group, replace it with an active reusable modifier group, and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MONEY_MOVEMENT_OPERATION_BLOCKED: A readiness condition prevents this money movement operation. Read the reported readiness reason and complete its required action before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MONEY_MOVEMENT_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: The money movement provider is not configured. Contact Flint support to configure the money movement provider.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MULTIPLE_IDENTITIES_FOUND: More than one identity matches the request. Choose the intended identity explicitly before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NEW_ACCOUNT_PAYOUT_TERMS_ACTIVE: Flint pays new live accounts at most once a week for their first 60 days. Choose a schedule that pays out at most once a week, keep delay_days_override at or above delay_days, or make the change after payout_terms_expires_at.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOTHING_TO_REFUND: Nothing remains to refund: the order or payment is fully refunded, or a bank return already took the money back. Treat the refund as already complete. List the order's refunds and disputes to see where the money went.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOTHING_TO_REFUND_FOR_CHARGE: A charge in the request has nothing left to refund. Remove the fully refunded charge from charges and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOTHING_TO_REFUND_FOR_LINE_ITEM: A line item in the request has nothing left to refund. Remove the fully refunded line item from line_items and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOTHING_TO_REFUND_FOR_TAX_BREAKDOWN: The selected flat tax has no refundable amount remaining. Remove the tax breakdown from the request or read the order and its refunds before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOT_ALLOWED: This request cannot use the field's value. Change the field named by param to a value this request can use.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NO_DISCOUNTABLE_BALANCE: No order balance is eligible for the requested discount. Remove the discount or add eligible line item value, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NO_PAYMENTS_FOR_ORDER: The order has no succeeded payments to refund. Wait for a processing payment to succeed before refunding, or leave the order unrefunded if nothing was collected.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ONBOARDING_CONTROLLER_VERSION_UNSUPPORTE: The application release cannot resume the provider-account controller policy frozen on this onboarding attempt. Contact Flint support before retrying. Account setup cannot resume until Flint restores support for this account's setup configuration.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ONBOARDING_PROFILE_PROVIDER_MANAGED: The account profile is managed through the embedded account experience after provider account setup begins. Open an account-management session and edit the profile there.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS: Flint is finishing other work on the resource. Wait for Retry-After when present, then resend the same request with the same Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_HAS_ACTIVE_INVOICE: The order already has an active invoice. Use the invoice listed in blocking_resources or void it before creating another.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_HAS_PAYMENTS: The order already has a payment, so it cannot be invoiced. Inspect the payments and owning invoices listed in blocking_resources. Invoice an unpaid order, or collect the remaining balance another way.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_HAS_REFUNDS: The order has a refund, so it cannot be invoiced. Inspect the refunds listed in blocking_resources. Invoice an order that has no refunds.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_PAID: This change isn't allowed after the order has received a payment. Keep the current settings. Change order charges or tax mode and enablement only before the order receives a payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED: The order changed after the caller prepared the request. Refresh the order or checkout session and rebuild the request from current state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CHECKOUT_SESSION_CHANGED: The order's open checkout session changed while this request was running. Retry the request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_COLLECTION_ALREADY_ACTIVE: Another collection flow is already active for this order. Finish or close the collection resource listed in blocking_resources before starting another flow.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_COLLECTION_IN_PROGRESS: A checkout or invoice flow currently owns collection for the order. Finish or close the collection resource listed in blocking_resources before starting another payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CONFLICT: The order changed before this request could commit. Read the current order and retry the intended change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CUSTOMER_ALREADY_SET: The order already belongs to a customer and cannot be reassigned. Keep the current customer_id or create a new order for a different customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CUSTOMER_CHECKOUT_ACTIVE: An open checkout already owns collection for the order, so customer authority cannot change under its issued credential. Close the checkout session listed in blocking_resources before setting customer_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CUSTOMER_NOT_UPDATABLE_AFTER_PAYME: The order customer cannot change after payment begins. Set customer_id before starting payment, or keep the current customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_DELIVERY_DESTINATION_REPRICE_REQUI: The new delivery destination changes shipping or tax, or the paid delivery method is unavailable. Refund and cancel the order, or contact the buyer before arranging delivery to a different destination.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_FINANCIAL_MUTATION_NOT_ALLOWED: The order's financial fields cannot change after a refund is created. Use an explicit refund or credit adjustment instead of changing the order total.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_ACTIVE_PAYMENT_INTENT: The order has an active payment intent, so the order cannot be invoiced or the invoice cannot be sent. Cancel the payment intents listed in blocking_resources, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_COLLECTED_MONEY: The order kept money it collected. Refund it with POST /v1/refunds and order_id before closing, or send collected_money_behavior: keep to close and keep it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_MANUAL_PAYMENTS: The order has recorded manual payments, so the order cannot be invoiced or the invoice cannot be sent. Reverse the manual payments on the invoices listed in blocking_resources, or collect the remaining balance on the existing invoice.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_NO_LINE_ITEMS: The order has no line items. Add line items to the order before issuing its invoice, or refund by amount_money without line_items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_NO_REFUNDABLE_CHARGES: The request names charges, but none of the order's charges has a settled amount left to refund. Remove charges from the request, or refund the order's line items or amount_money instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_NO_REFUNDABLE_LINE_ITEMS: The request names line items, but none of the order's line items has a settled amount left to refund for this payment. Remove line_items from the request, or refund the order's charges or amount_money instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_OPEN_CHECKOUT: The order has an open checkout session, so the order cannot be invoiced or the invoice cannot be sent. Close the checkout sessions listed in blocking_resources, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_INVENTORY_EXCEPTION_NOT_RESOLVABLE: The order has no paid inventory failure to resolve. Resolve only orders whose inventory_exception_status is paid_inventory_failed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_INVENTORY_EXCEPTION_UNRESOLVED: The order has an unresolved paid inventory failure, so its fulfillments cannot change. Resolve the order's inventory exception, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_NOT_FULFILLABLE: Fulfillments can change only while the order's payment_status is paid. Read the order and retry after its payment_status is paid.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_NOT_OPEN: The order is closed or fully paid, so it cannot accept this action. Read the order and continue from its current state, or use an open order with an unpaid balance.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_ACTIVE: The order has lock-owning payment work in progress. Read active_payment_attempt. Resume it only when is_resumable is true; otherwise cancel, capture, or resolve it as allowed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH: The order's customer does not match the customer of the selected payment intents or of this checkout. Use payment intents and a checkout for the order's customer_id, or ask the merchant to update the order's customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_INTENT_CREATE_IN_PROGRESS: Creation of an order-owned payment intent with this idempotency key is still in progress. Retry the same request with the same idempotency key using exponential backoff with jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_INTENT_CREATE_REQUIRES_REV: Flint could not automatically reconcile the creation of the order's payment intent. Contact support with the request_id and the order ID. Do not start another payment for the order until support confirms the payment intent's state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_LEG_ALREADY_SETTLED: The order payment leg already settled and cannot be canceled. Create a refund or reversal instead of canceling the payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_LEG_CHECKOUT_ACTIVE: A hosted checkout session is open for the order, and the order already has an unpaid payment leg. Cancel the leg in payment_intent_ids with POST /v1/payment-intents/{payment_intent_id}/cancel before you stage another, or close the session in existing_checkout_session_id and collect the split payment in your own payment UI.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_EMAIL_ON_FILE: This order already has a receipt email. Omit email to send to the address on file.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: The order does not have an email address that can receive a receipt. Add an email address to the customer or order, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_MERCHANT_MANAGED: Flint receipt delivery is disabled because the merchant sends its own receipts. Contact the merchant to request another receipt.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_NOT_AVAILABLE: The order does not have a paid receipt that can be sent. Check that the order has a successful payment before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_RECIPIENT_LIMIT_REACHED: This order already sent receipts to 3 email addresses, the limit for checkout credentials. Send to an address already used, or send the receipt with a secret API key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: The order payment state requires operational reconciliation before more money movement is safe. Read the order and its payments to confirm the outcome. Contact support with the request_id and order ID before starting another payment if the outcome is unresolved.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TAX_NOT_READY: The order's tax is not ready for issuing an invoice or collecting payment. For an order created by a return, tax follows the return and cannot be changed directly; read the return's current resolution. For other orders, read tax.status: send tax.location when requires_location; update the order's tax to recalculate when incomplete; then submit the request again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TAX_NOT_UPDATABLE: The order's tax follows its return or cannot change after payment. Keep the tax settings for an order whose tax follows its return. For other orders, set tax before starting payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TOTALS_UNAVAILABLE: Flint could not calculate the order's totals from its stored state. Contact support with the request_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TOTAL_BELOW_NET_COLLECTED: The change would reduce the order total, or its items and charges without the unpaid tip, below the money already collected. Use an explicit refund or credit adjustment instead of reducing the order total.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORGANIZATION_CYCLE: The new parent organization is a descendant of this organization. Choose a parent_organization_id outside this organization's subtree.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORGANIZATION_NOT_ACTIVE: The referenced organization is deleted. Choose an active organization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PACKAGE_CHANGED: Another write changed the package while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the package again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PACKAGE_PARENT_CHANGED: The package's shipment or fulfillment changed while the transition was running. Read the current package and its shipment or fulfillment, then retry the transition if it is still valid.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_MODIFIER_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: The line item's modifiers cannot change after the line item has been paid for. Keep the current modifiers, or add a new line item with the modifiers you need.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_PRICE_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: Line item prices cannot change after the order has received a payment. Keep the current unit_price_money, or add a new line item and refund the original instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_QUANTITY_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: The quantity of a paid line item cannot change. Add a new line item for additional quantity, or create a refund to reduce it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_QUANTITY_DECREASE_FORBIDD: The quantity is below the units already paid for or committed for this line item. Send a quantity at least as large as the paid or committed units, or create a refund instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_REMOVAL_FORBIDDEN: The line item has already been paid for and cannot be removed. Keep the line item and create a refund for it instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_TAX_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: Tax settings cannot change on settled line items or charges. Keep the line item's or charge's current tax settings, or add a new line item or charge.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAUSE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store doesn't let buyers pause subscriptions. Offer a pause only when the pause entry in buyer_actions is available.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ACTION_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT: The hosted payment attempt does not have enough remaining time to start a redirect payment. Start a fresh order payment attempt or choose card.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ALREADY_SETTLED: The payment method setup for this payment attempt has succeeded and cannot be canceled. Read the payment attempt and continue from its completed state instead of canceling it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_AMOUNT_CHANGED: The payment intent amount changed while the confirmation was starting. Retrieve the payment intent to check its amount, then confirm again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_ACTIVE: A payment attempt is still active. Resume, capture, or cancel the active attempt before starting another payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_MISMATCH: The submitted payment attempt does not own the selected payment intent. Refresh the order or payment attempt, then send the owning order_payment_attempt_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_NOT_CANCELABLE: The payment attempt already finished and cannot be canceled. Read the attempt status. A failed or expired attempt holds nothing to cancel, and settled money needs a refund instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_NOT_RESUMABLE: The requested payment attempt cannot be resumed from its current status. Read the attempt status and start, cancel, or capture only the work allowed by that state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_REQUIRES_CAPTURE: An authorized payment is waiting to be captured or canceled. Capture or cancel the payment attempt or payment intent listed in blocking_resources, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION_STATE_CHANGED: The confirmation request no longer matches the PaymentIntent's durable attempt. Refresh the PaymentIntent, then start a new confirmation only if its current state permits it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_CONFIRM_IN_PROGRESS: A different confirmation of this payment intent is already in progress. Wait for confirmation of the payment intent in blocking_resources to finish. Confirm again only if it still requires confirmation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_INTENT_DISPUTED: A payment has an active or lost chargeback and cannot be refunded. Read the payment's dispute_status and refund an eligible payment instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_INTENT_LIMIT_REACHED: The order has reached its lifetime limit of payment intents. Create a new order to collect this payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: A payment on this resource is still in progress. Wait for the payment to finish, then retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key. blocking_resources names the blocking resource when Flint knows it: a checkout session, invoice, payment attempt, or payment intent.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LEG_SELECTION_REQUIRED: The order payment request needs an explicit payment-leg selection. Select the payment intents listed in the error details, create an order-owned leg, or use payment_source when no selectable leg exists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_CHANGED_RETRY: The payment link changed before the checkout publication committed. Read the public payment link again and start a new resolve operation with a new context and idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_FULFILLMENT_UNAVAILABLE: The payment link references delivery configuration that is not currently available. Update the payment link to use active delivery methods, then resolve it again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_INACTIVE: The payment link is inactive, so it cannot start a checkout. Show inactive_message to the buyer when present. The merchant must set the payment link status to active before buyers can use it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_MAX_COMPLETIONS_REACHED: The payment link has reached its maximum number of completions. Use another payment link, or raise the link's max_completions.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_RESOLUTION_CONTEXT_REFRESH_: The resolution context expired, no longer matches the link delivery methods, or has too little time left to start checkout. Read the public payment link again and start a new resolve operation with the refreshed context.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_RESOLUTION_REPLAY_UNAVAILAB: The checkout recorded for this payment-link operation can no longer issue authentication. Read the public payment link again and start a new checkout operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_SALES_ENDED: Sales through the payment link have ended. Show inactive_message to the buyer when present. The merchant can set a later sales_end_at on the payment link to sell again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH: The payment method belongs to a different customer. Use an active payment method owned by the subscription customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_DOMAIN_OPERATION_IN_PROGR: Another payment method domain operation is still in progress. Wait for the active operation to finish, then retry with the same Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_HAS_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTIONS: A subscription that is not canceled still uses the payment method. Move each subscription to another payment method or cancel it, then retry.
