x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_ACTIVE: The saved payment method is not active. Use an active saved payment method, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_READY: The payment method setup has not finished. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key once the buyer finishes card setup.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_ON_SESSION_ONLY: The buyer saved this card for checkout only, so Flint does not charge it without them. Use a payment method whose usage is off_session, or collect a card the buyer saves for future charges.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED: A required saved payment method was not provided or could not be resolved. Provide or collect an active saved payment method, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_SAVE_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: An emailed code can't confirm this card: the customer's email isn't the email this checkout's payment was made with. Confirm the card with the code texted to the number given with the payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_SAVE_NOT_PENDING: The card from this checkout's payment no longer waits for confirmation: it is saved, or was not confirmed within 24 hours. Read payment_method_save on the checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_SAVE_NOT_READY: No card from this checkout's payment waits for confirmation yet; the payment may still be finishing. Read the checkout session again in a few seconds, then request the code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_NOT_REQUIRED: The collection context has no outstanding balance to charge. Complete the zero-balance order without a payment source, or use setup_payment_source for an allowed future-billing setup.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS: Another operation is in progress for this payment intent. Wait for the operation on the payment intent listed in blocking_resources to finish, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The invoice balance exceeds the configured limit for this payment option. Use an allowed payment option with a sufficient limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTION_NOT_READY: The payment option has one or more readiness blockers. Use the error details to identify every blocker, its reason, and the responsible next step.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTION_UNAVAILABLE: The requested payment option is not available for this merchant, amount, or checkout. The amount_out_of_range reason means the amount is outside this payment option's limits. Choose a payment option that is enabled and available for this merchant and amount, or enable one in settings, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_PROCESSING_NOT_ENABLED: Flint has not enabled payment processing for this merchant environment. Contact Flint support with the request_id. Retrying the same request fails until Flint enables processing.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE: Payment processing is temporarily unavailable for this merchant environment. Retry with exponential backoff and jitter. Contact support with the request_id if processing remains unavailable.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_REJECTED: The payment processor rejected the request. Retrieve the payment intent to check its current status and amount, correct the request if needed, then retry with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_UNAVAILABLE: The merchant has no payment processor account set up for this environment. Complete the merchant's onboarding requirements for this environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_REVIEW_OPEN: The payment has an open risk review and must be approved before it can be captured. Approve the review named in blocking_resources and remediation.next_actions, then retry the capture.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The submitted payment source is no longer available for this attempt. Collect or select another payment source and start a new attempt.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUTS_NOT_ENABLED: Payouts are not enabled for this merchant. Check status_reason and next_actions in readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant, complete them, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_DELAY_PROVIDER_CONTROLLED: The provider controls the payout delay. Change the payout delay through the provider that controls it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_DESTINATIONS_MANAGEMENT_UNAVAILAB: Payout destinations cannot be managed for this merchant. Check the manage_payout_destinations capability in readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant, complete its next actions, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_FEE_NOT_DETERMINABLE: Flint cannot determine the payout fee. Contact Flint support with the request_id before starting another payout.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_NOT_CANCELABLE: The payout cannot be canceled in its current status. Read the payout and check current_status before attempting to cancel it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_SETTINGS_MANAGED_EXTERNALLY: Another system manages the payout settings. Update the payout settings through the system that manages them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_SETTINGS_MANAGEMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Payout settings cannot be managed for this merchant. Check the manage_payout_settings capability in readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant, complete its next actions, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STATUS_NOT_CANCELABLE: The payout's current status does not allow cancellation. Inspect current_status and retrieve the payout to confirm its outcome.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE: The subscription plan is inactive or archived. Use an active subscription plan.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROCESSING_FEE_PRICING_NOT_AUTHORIZED: No authorized processing price covers this payment, so it was rejected before reaching the processor. Contact the merchant account owner to confirm that this payment option and amount are enabled. Retrying the same request will not succeed until the account configuration changes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROCESSOR_NOT_CONFIGURED: The merchant has not finished live account setup with the payment processor. Complete merchant onboarding, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROFILE_UPDATE_STATUS_UNKNOWN: Flint could not confirm the account profile update. Read the merchant profile to confirm whether the update applied before sending another update. Contact support with the request_id if the outcome cannot be determined.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_CODES_DISABLED: Promotion codes are turned off in the merchant's promotion settings. Set promotions.codes_enabled to true with PATCH /v1/settings first, or stop turning on promotion codes in the field identified by param.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_DECLINED: The promotion could not be applied to this order. Use reason to correct the promotion or order inputs, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_HAS_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION_OFFERS: Active subscription offers use this promotion, and an offer's discount must apply to every renewal. Remove the promotion from the offers in blocking_resources, or make those offers inactive, then change the recurrence.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_NOT_REDEEMABLE: Another payment took this promotion's last use while this payment was starting. Another payment took this promotion's last use while this payment was starting. Retry with a new Idempotency-Key. Flint then removes the discount and returns ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED, so show the buyer the new total before paying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_SHAPE_IMMUTABLE: A redeemed promotion cannot change its discount_class or application_method type. Keep the current discount_class and application_method type, or create a new promotion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROVIDER_ACCOUNT_CLEANUP_REQUIRED: The provider account needs cleanup before setup can continue. Contact Flint support to resolve the provider account before continuing setup.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.QUANTITY_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store doesn't offer other quantities for this subscription. Change it only when the subscription's quantity_options lists more than one option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.QUANTITY_NOT_ADJUSTABLE: quantity_overrides names a line item whose quantity buyers cannot change. Remove the line item from quantity_overrides.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The request exceeded the configured rate limit. Retry with exponential backoff and jitter. Use the Retry-After header when present.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_PAYMENT_INTENT_NOT_REF: A named line item or adjustment refund is tied to a payment that has nothing left to refund on the order. Remove the target tied to that payment, or refund it from a payment that still has a refundable amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT: The line items and adjustment refunds tied to one payment add up to more than that payment can still refund. Read the order's payments and refunds, and lower the named line items or adjustment_refunds amounts for that payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_REFUND_EXCEEDS_REMAINI: The adjustment refund amount is more than the adjustment's remaining withheld amount. Read the adjustment's remaining_money on the original refund and send no more than that amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_SUBMISSION_DEADLINE_EXPIRED: The payment method's provider refund-submission window has ended. Reimburse the customer outside the original payment method and preserve the Refund history for reconciliation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_TENDER_CAPACITY_CONFLICT: Refund allocations do not cover the order components the refund selects. Read the order and its refunds, then allocate each selected line item, charge, and flat tax to the tenders that paid for it. Submit the revised allocations with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REPORT_DOWNLOAD_EXPIRED: The report download expired. Create a new report for the same interval.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_BLOCKED: Flint's firewall blocked the request before it reached the API because its body contains a URL that points to a private, loopback, or cloud metadata address. Remove any URL that points to a private, loopback, or cloud metadata address from the request, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_BODY_TOO_LARGE: The request body is larger than the endpoint accepts. Send a body within the limit named in the error message. Split a large write into several requests, such as adding order line items in batches.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_CANCELED: The request was canceled before it completed. Send the request again if you still need it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The request timed out before Flint could complete it. Retry with exponential backoff. Contact support with the request_id if the timeout persists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUIRED: A required field is missing. Send the field named by param, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RESOURCE_IN_USE: References to this resource prevent the change. Resolve the references in details[0].blocking_resources before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The requested resource could not be found for the authenticated merchant and environment. Check the resource ID, mode, and merchant context, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED: This order collects a return balance. Use POST /v1/return-resolutions/{return_resolution_id}/checkout-session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_COMPLETION_BLOCKED: The Return still has completion blockers. Read completion_blockers, resolve each outstanding fact or effect, and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_DISPOSITION_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED: The disposition exceeds available receipt or finalized inspection capacity. Read the current receipt or inspection line capacity and submit an available quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_FULFILLMENT_ALLOCATION_AMBIGUOUS: The Order line belongs to multiple completed Fulfillments. Choose one of the candidate fulfillment_id values returned by the error.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_INSPECTION_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED: The inspection exceeds current receipt-line capacity. Read the current receipt line and inspect only its available quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_LINE_CANCELLATION_CONFLICT: The requested Return line quantity is no longer safely cancelable. Use available_quantity and blocking_resources to cancel a smaller quantity or resolve the blocking work first.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_POLICY_CONFLICT: More than one Return policy matched with the same precedence. Change policy priority or scope so the evaluation has one deterministic winner.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_RECEIPT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED: The receipt verification exceeds outstanding handback capacity. Read the Return line quantities and verify only the available quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_SELF_SERVICE_NOT_ALLOWED: The return policy does not allow the buyer to request this return or resolution. Ask the merchant to review the request under their return policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_SHIPMENT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILAB: The return shipment quantity exceeds the remaining declared shipment capacity. Read the return line quantities and send only the quantity still available for shipment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_VALUE_EXCEEDED: The proposed resolution exceeds available Return quantity or value. Preview or read the current Return and allocate only unreserved value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_VERSION_CONFLICT: Another write changed the Return while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the Return again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RISK_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_PAYMENT_FL: A risk rule requires 3D Secure, which this payment flow cannot complete because the cardholder is not present. Send the customer a payment link, or change the rule to skip this payment_flow.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RISK_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_PAYMENT_OP: A risk rule requires an action, such as review or 3D Secure, that the selected payment option does not support. Use a different payment option, or change the risk rule.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RISK_RULE_LIMIT_REACHED: The environment has reached its enabled risk rule limit. Disable an enabled risk rule before creating or enabling another.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: No public API route matched the request path. Check the path and remove unsupported trailing slashes or legacy routes before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RULE_RESERVED: This rule is reserved. Use a rule that this operation can change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SANDBOX_ARCHIVED: The sandbox is archived. Select an active sandbox.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SANDBOX_INACTIVE: The sandbox is inactive. Select an active sandbox.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE_LIMIT_REACHED: No more confirmation codes are available for this card on this channel. Confirm the saved card through the other channel.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_OFFERED: This checkout does not offer saving the buyer's card. Read the checkout session with its checkout credential and send save_payment_method only when can_save_payment_method is true.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_VERIFICATION_REQUIRE: Saving the card needs the buyer's email confirmed in this checkout first. Request a code with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications, confirm it, then pay again with the checkout credential the confirmation returned.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SENSITIVE_IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_INVALID: A secret-bearing mutation did not provide the recovery metadata required for safe durable replay. Read the resource or list the route's results to confirm the outcome. Contact Flint support with the request_id if the outcome cannot be determined.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: A service required to complete the request is temporarily unavailable. Retry with exponential backoff. Contact support with the request_id if the error persists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SETUP_SOURCE_NON_ZERO_ORDER: setup_payment_source can only be used when the order has no balance to pay. Pay the outstanding balance with payment_source or payment_intents, or use setup_payment_source only for a zero-balance subscription order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_CHANGED: Another write changed the shipment while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the shipment again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_PACKAGE_ITEM_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_F: The package items for this order line item would exceed its fulfillment quantity. Reduce quantity so the line's package items total no more than its quantity on the fulfillment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_PACKAGE_NOT_VOIDABLE: A package can be voided only while its status is created or packed. Read the package status, and void a package or its shipment only while every affected package is created or packed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SKIP_LIMIT_REACHED: The buyer has reached the store's consecutive skip limit. Wait for the next charged cycle, which resets the skip count, or ask the merchant to skip this cycle.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SKIP_NOT_ALLOWED: The store does not allow buyers to skip subscription cycles. Ask the store to skip the cycle or enable customer_account.buyer_capabilities.skip.enabled.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.STANDARD_PAYOUTS_UNAVAILABLE: Standard payouts are not enabled for this merchant. Check the create_standard_payouts capability in readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant, complete its next actions, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.STANDARD_PAYOUT_REQUIRES_MANUAL_SCHEDULE: Standard manual payouts require a manual payout schedule. Change the payout schedule interval to manual before creating a standard payout.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_LINES_NOT_COMBINAB: Subscribed items with the same billing interval share one shipment, but these items ship separately, so one delivery choice can't cover them. Resume returns it as a 409 conflict when a paused subscription's items no longer ship together. In an order, give one of the items a different billing interval, or buy it once. In a subscription plan, put the items in separate plans. On a subscription, change the items' delivery profiles so they ship together, or replace or remove one of the items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_MIGRATION_IN_PROGR: A migration already moves subscribers off this method. Wait for the migration identified in details to finish before starting another.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_MIGRATION_TARGET_U: The destination delivery method is not active. Choose an active shipment or local delivery method.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_PROFILE_ACTION_REQ: A physical subscription line's delivery profile needs configuration. Complete the delivery profile for the catalog variant identified in the error details, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_PROFILE_MISSING: A physical subscription line has no delivery profile. Assign a configured delivery profile to the catalog variant identified in the error details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: The selected delivery method cannot serve this subscription. Delivery and line item writes return it as a validation error; resume and renew return it as a 409 conflict when the stored delivery can no longer be used. Choose an offered delivery method that serves the address, or correct the address before retrying. If the rate is unavailable, retry later, update the delivery recipient, or contact the store.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_NEXT_BILLING_AT_BEFORE_PERI: The requested next billing time is before the current subscription period starts. Set next_billing_at to current_period_start_at or a later time.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_NEXT_BILLING_AT_TOO_FAR: The Flint-owned billing date moves more than one plan interval forward. Choose a date within one plan interval or pause the subscription.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_ARCHIVED: The subscription offer has been archived. Create another offer. Archived offers cannot be changed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_NOT_ACTIVE: The subscription offer is not active. Choose an active offer or purchase this line once.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_PROMOTION_UNAVAILABLE: The offer promotion is archived, disabled, expired, not yet started, used up (max_uses reached), or its targeting excludes the offer products and variants. Choose a promotion that can apply without a code to new subscribers.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_TARGET_CONFLICT: A catalog target already has an active subscription offer. Change the target or deactivate the offer identified in details before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_RETRY_IN_PROGRESS: A payment retry is already in progress for this subscription. Poll the current payment retry until it succeeds or fails before starting another.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED: This subscription has reached 3 payment retries for the current billing period, including retries started by the store. Contact the store for help recovering the past-due payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_START_OVERRIDE_NOT_ALLOWED: A paid checkout cannot use a scheduled or imported subscription start. Use the immediate billing_start branch for a checkout that already collected payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SWAP_NOT_ALLOWED: The store doesn't offer other items for this subscription line. Swap only to a variant listed in the line's plan swap_variants.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_BREAKDOWN_REFUND_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: The tax refund is more than the jurisdiction tax that remains refundable. Read the order's tax breakdowns and refunds, and refund no more tax than remains for each tax_breakdown_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_CATEGORY_REQUIRED: Live payments are paused until a supported automatic tax category is chosen. Choose a supported automatic tax category in tax settings.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TEST_PROCESSOR_NOT_CONFIGURED: The merchant has not connected a test payment processor account. Connect a test processor account for this environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TICKET_PREFIX_LOCKED: event_config.ticket_prefix cannot change after the event has issued tickets. Keep the current ticket_prefix, or create a new event payment link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TIP_ALLOCATION_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: The balance left to collect is smaller than the order's unpaid tip, so no payment can carry the tip. A manual payment usually covered part of the tip without recording it. Contact support with the request_id to record the tip.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_FIELD: The request sent a field or query parameter this route does not accept. Remove or correct the unknown field. If you send a corrected write, use a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE: The request body used an unsupported Content-Type. Send JSON request bodies with Content-Type: application/json, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_PROCESSOR: This merchant environment has no supported payment processor account yet. Complete account setup for this environment through onboarding, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.VARIANT_NOT_SELLABLE: The variant or its product is inactive or unavailable for sale. Choose a sellable variant or activate the product and variant and make the variant available for sale.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.VERSION_CONFLICT: The resource changed and the request must be rebuilt from its current state. Read the resource again, rebuild the change from its current state, and send the new version in the same field.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_IN_FLIGHT: Another attempt for this webhook delivery is in progress. Wait for Retry-After, then retry the same request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_ACTIVE: The webhook endpoint is inactive. Set the endpoint status to active and resolve any endpoint configuration issue before resending.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED: The webhook endpoint does not subscribe to this event. Add the event type to the endpoint's enabled_events (and, for partner endpoints, events_from or mode), then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.WEBHOOK_EVENT_PAYLOAD_EXPIRED: The retained webhook event payload has expired. Use a newer webhook event. Expired payloads cannot be resent.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_LIMIT_REACHED: The merchant already has 100 non-archived workload identities across all environments. Archive an unused workload identity, then create the new identity.

collected_money.description: On ORDER_HAS_COLLECTED_MONEY, collected money still refundable through POST /v1/refunds with order_id, after pending refunds. Refund it before closing or send collected_money_behavior: keep.

conflict_type.description: Which inventory count check failed for this line. Sent on VERSION_CONFLICT for physical observations and INVENTORY_SOURCE_SEQUENCE_CHANGED.
x-enum-descriptions: On-hand or condition quantities at the level changed after the observation was read and counted. Compare captured_physical_version with current_physical_version, then recount.
The submitted source observation sequence is not newer than the latest accepted one. Compare submitted_source_observation_sequence with current_source_observation_sequence.

conflicting_fields.description: Request field paths that conflict with each other or with the rest of the request. Sent on INVALID_REQUEST with detail NOT_ALLOWED for conflicting payment inputs, and with detail INVALID_VALUE when entries in one product create repeat an option name, identifier, or selected option combination.

current_api_version.description: Current API version pin on VERSION_CONFLICT when expected_api_version is stale.

current_checkout_session_id.description: On CHECKOUT_SESSION_CURRENT_CHANGED, the ID of the checkout session that is current. The request named an earlier one.

current_delivery_selection_id.description: Current effective delivery selection ID on VERSION_CONFLICT when expected_delivery_selection_id is stale. Present as null when no delivery selection is current.

current_interval.description: Current payout schedule interval on STANDARD_PAYOUT_REQUIRES_MANUAL_SCHEDULE. Change the payout schedule to manual before creating a standard payout.

current_money.description: Current money amount counted toward the threshold, when the error is threshold-based. On ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED and PAYMENT_LEG_SELECTION_REQUIRED, the order's current outstanding balance. On ORDER_TOTAL_BELOW_NET_COLLECTED, what the change would leave: the order total, or the total without its unpaid tip when items and charges would fall below the money collected for them. On CREDIT_NOTE_ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_BALANCE, the outstanding balance the allocation would leave.

current_physical_version.description: Current physical version of the inventory level. This is a physical-value assertion, not the resource version in current_version.

current_resource.description: The existing resource reference or custom domain on ALREADY_EXISTS, or the current fulfillment, shipment, or package when a conditional write conflicts with resource state.

current_selection_id.description: Current effective delivery selection ID returned with a selection concurrency conflict.

current_source_observation_sequence.description: Latest accepted absolute source sequence for this item and Location.

current_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the resource when the requested mutation is not allowed.

current_version.description: Current version of the resource when a write that depends on its version or status is rejected. Sent on VERSION_CONFLICT and other stale-basis conflicts such as ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED, and on status conflicts such as ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED. On ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED, send the order version as expected_version. Read the resource again before you retry.

delivery_method_id.description: Delivery method this failure concerns. On SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE, the method that cannot currently serve the subscription.

demand_key.description: Key of the inventory demand this failure concerns. Sent on INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT, and on INVENTORY_LOCATION_INELIGIBLE when one demand cannot use the Location.

demo_session_id.description: On ACTIVE_DEMO_SESSION_EXISTS and DEMO_SESSION_SECRET_REPLAY_EXPIRED, the ID of this client's current demo session. Send it to POST /v1/demo-sessions/reset to replace that session.

dependency_type.description: Stable dependency category blocking a Location lifecycle transition.

eligibility_reason.description: On INVENTORY_LOCATION_INELIGIBLE, why the Location in location_id cannot supply the demand.
x-enum-descriptions: The demand's forced_location_id names a different Location.
The Location is not in the demand's allowed_location_ids.
The demand's splitting_behavior is single_location, and the Location has some but not all of the quantity.
The Location does not have enough available quantity for the demand.

existing_checkout_session_id.description: ID of the open checkout session that already owns the order. Sent on CHECKOUT_SURFACE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED, ORDER_PAYMENT_LEG_CHECKOUT_ACTIVE, and ORDER_CUSTOMER_CHECKOUT_ACTIVE. Recover the session from this field, not from message.

expected_attempt_outstanding_money.description: On ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED when you resume a payment attempt, the outstanding balance the attempt started with. expected_outstanding_money must match it.

failure_category.description: Delivery pricing failure category on SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE, when the rate cannot be calculated.

failure_code.description: Decline reason for a failed payment, from the same vocabulary as the payment's last_payment_error.code. Unrecognized provider reasons are payment_failed.

gap_money.description: Additional money amount needed to satisfy the threshold, when the error is threshold-based. On ORDER_TOTAL_BELOW_NET_COLLECTED, how far current_money falls below required_money.

inactive_message.description: Merchant-provided buyer-facing text on PAYMENT_LINK_INACTIVE. Present only when the merchant set an inactive message.

inventory_count_line_id.description: Inventory count line this conflict concerns. Sent on VERSION_CONFLICT for physical observations and INVENTORY_SOURCE_SEQUENCE_CHANGED.

inventory_item_id.description: Inventory item this failure concerns. Sent on INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT, INVENTORY_LOCATION_INELIGIBLE, VERSION_CONFLICT for physical observations, and INVENTORY_SOURCE_SEQUENCE_CHANGED.

invoice_payment_attempt_id.description: ID of the invoice payment attempt this error concerns. On INVOICE_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_ACTIVE and INVOICE_PAYMENT_PROCESSING, the invoice's open payment attempt.

is_resumable.description: Whether the payment attempt identified by order_payment_attempt_id or invoice_payment_attempt_id can be resumed. On order payment attempt errors, if false, read payment_attempt_status before starting another payment. Invoice payment attempt errors always send false.

limit.description: The limit that was reached. On RISK_RULE_LIMIT_REACHED, the most enabled risk rules in the environment. On PAYMENT_INTENT_LIMIT_REACHED, the most payment intents an order can have over its lifetime. On SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED, the most payment retries a subscription allows in one billing period.

line_item_key.description: Key of the line item whose modifiers changed: the payment link line item key when the checkout came from a payment link, otherwise the order line item ID.

location_id.description: Location this failure concerns. Sent on INVENTORY_LOCATION_INELIGIBLE, VERSION_CONFLICT for physical observations, INVENTORY_SOURCE_SEQUENCE_CHANGED, PICKUP_LOCATION_INACTIVE, PICKUP_LOCATION_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE, PICKUP_LOCATION_GEOGRAPHY_UNAVAILABLE, and PICKUP_LOCATION_DEPENDENCY_FAILURE.

location_outcome.description: On INVENTORY_LOCATION_INELIGIBLE, the routing outcome for the Location in location_id: for the demand in demand_key when present, otherwise for every demand.
x-enum-descriptions: The Location cannot supply the demand. eligibility_reason says why.

maximum_money.description: Maximum money amount accepted by the failed validation, calculated from the current resource state.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of this failure for your logs. The wording can change, so branch on code.

missing_scopes.description: Unsatisfied entries from scope_requirement after write-implies-read evaluation.

order_charge_id.description: Existing order charge this failure concerns. Set when the order charge is already on the order; when the request body does not contain it, param is omitted and details name the affected fields relative to this order charge.

order_id.description: Renewal order whose payment attempt failed.

order_line_item_id.description: Existing order line item this failure concerns. Set when the order line item is already on the order; when the request body does not contain it, param is omitted and details name the affected fields relative to this order line item.

order_payment_attempt_id.description: ID of the order payment attempt this error concerns. On ORDER_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_ACTIVE, the order's active payment attempt. On PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_NOT_RESUMABLE, the order payment attempt that can no longer be resumed. On INVALID_REQUEST with param order_payment_attempt_id, the order payment attempt that owns the payment intent.

param.description: Public JSON request field path associated with this failure. Always present on INVALID_REQUEST details; body for a whole-body failure, or the header name for a header.

payment_attempt_status.description: Status of the payment attempt identified by order_payment_attempt_id or invoice_payment_attempt_id when the error was returned.

payment_intent_ids.description: Payment intent IDs this error concerns. On ORDER_PAYMENT_LEG_CHECKOUT_ACTIVE and CHECKOUT_SPLIT_PAYMENT_UNSUPPORTED, the order's unpaid payment intents, which you can cancel to collect the order through hosted checkout. On INVALID_REQUEST with param payment_intent_id, the selected payment intent that this order does not own.

payment_method_domain_id.description: On ALREADY_EXISTS, the ID of the payment method domain already registered for this domain_name. Use it instead of registering the domain again.

payment_option.description: Flint payment option associated with this error, when the error is about a specific requested or selected payment option.

payout_terms_expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC when the new account payout terms end on NEW_ACCOUNT_PAYOUT_TERMS_ACTIVE. Sent at second precision. Choose an allowed schedule or delay, or make the change after this time.

previous_key_expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the previous signing key expires on DELIVERY_RATE_CALLBACK_SECRET_ROTATION_OVERLAP_ACTIVE. Retry after this time, or revoke the current key before rotating if it leaked.

quota.description: Structured resource quota state when the error is caused by quota exhaustion.

reason.description: Stable Flint reason code associated with this error. For payment option availability errors this matches PaymentOptionBlocker.code. When code is PAYMENT_PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE, PAYMENT_OPTION_UNAVAILABLE, or MONEY_MOVEMENT_OPERATION_BLOCKED, platform_funding_unavailable identifies a stop on Flint's platform that requires no merchant changes. When code is PROMOTION_DECLINED, branch on reason. Promotion decline reasons are: already_applied, automatic_disabled, buy_item_missing, code_invalid, code_required, codes_disabled, currency_mismatch, exhausted, expired, inactive, max_promotions_reached, minimum_not_met, no_discountable_balance, not_combinable, not_eligible, not_yet_started, superseded, superseded_by_better_offer, superseded_by_higher_priority, unknown_type. When code is ORDER_DELIVERY_DESTINATION_REPRICE_REQUIRED, current reasons are shipping_changed, tax_changed, and method_unavailable. Additional reasons may be added. When code is NEW_ACCOUNT_PAYOUT_TERMS_ACTIVE, reason is payout_frequency for a schedule that pays out too often, or payout_delay for a delay_days_override below delay_days. When code is CHECKOUT_SESSION_MODIFIERS_READ_ONLY, reason is existing_order_checkout, invoice_finalized, or subscription_terms_locked. When code is GIFT_CARD_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED, reason is proof_required, proof_rejected, or page_origin_required. When code is ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED, reason is required and is one of: order_owned, authorization_expired, not_paused, period_end_unavailable, configuration_required, already_applied, terminal_status, not_itemized, status_not_reached, in_progress, archived, field_locked, unsupported_state, merchant_managed_receipts, derived_from_packages, on_hold, bank_return_not_contestable, dispute_payment_unavailable, refund_unavailable, store_credit_unavailable, refund_created, payment_collected, cancellation_scheduled, trial_in_progress, external_billing_schedule, delivery_hold, payment_required, initial_payment_pending, inventory_wait, credit_note_tax_reconciliation_required, credit_exceeds_charge, delivery_requirement_changes, offer_subscription. configuration_required means the named resource needs configuration before this action; current_status is omitted. Additional reasons may be added. Branch on reason and fall back to current_status for unknown reasons. When code is FORBIDDEN, live_mode_required means the request requires a live-mode credential.

required_money.description: Money amount required to satisfy a minimum threshold, when the error is threshold-based. On ORDER_TOTAL_BELOW_NET_COLLECTED, the money already collected for the order. On CREDIT_NOTE_ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_BALANCE, the order's unpaid tip the invoice must keep outstanding.

resource_type.description: Public resource named by RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND or a generic conflict: a ResourceType value, or resource when the resource has no public type.

risk_rule_ids.description: On RESOURCE_IN_USE, the enabled risk rules that reference the list. Archive or disable them before you archive the list.

scope.description: Canonical public scope rejected by validation, when the detail concerns one scope.

scope_requirement.description: Complete route or delegation scope requirement for an INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE error.

selectable_merchants.description: Merchants available to this developer identity when code is MERCHANT_SELECTION_REQUIRED or INVALID_MERCHANT_SELECTION. Retry with one of the returned merchant_id values.

selectable_payment_intents.description: On PAYMENT_LEG_SELECTION_REQUIRED, the order's payment intents you can choose from. Retry with a payment_intents selection built from these.

shipping_money.description: Committed shipping total on the paid order when its destination cannot change without repricing.

shortage_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

submitted_money.description: Amount from your request that failed the check. On TIP_ALLOCATION_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, the unpaid tip the payment would have to carry. On ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED, the expected_outstanding_money you sent, or the total of the selected payment legs when they do not fit the outstanding balance.

submitted_source_observation_sequence.description: Absolute source sequence submitted for this inventory count line.

subscription_delivery_migration_id.description: Subscription delivery migration associated with the error.

subscription_offer_id.description: Subscription offer associated with the error.

subscription_plan_line_item_id.description: Subscription plan line item associated with the error.

suggestions.description: Concrete corrective actions for this validation error.

supported_actions.description: Actions accepted for the current resource state.

supported_api_versions.description: On INVALID_REQUEST with param Flint-Version, and on API_VERSION_RETIRED, the API versions you can use now.

surface.description: On CHECKOUT_SURFACE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED, the current surface of the checkout session in existing_checkout_session_id: hosted or embedded. Request this surface to keep using that session.

tax_money.description: Committed tax total on a paid order when its destination cannot change without repricing.

tip_capable_money.description: On TIP_ALLOCATION_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, the largest tip the payment can carry: the balance left to collect.

unavailable_reason.description: Delivery eligibility reason on SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE, when the selected method is unavailable.

error.description: Error code, message, request context, and guidance for resolving the failure.

x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCESS_LINK_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: The resource has no customer, and an access link opens a resource only for its customer. Set customer_id on orders before payment to link their buyers to them and to their returns.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCESS_LINK_MERCHANT_HOSTED: The merchant hosts its own customer account, so Flint has no account page for an access link to open. Show the resource in your own account with a customer session, or set customer_account.mode to flint_hosted.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SETUP_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT: The stored account-provisioning configuration is not supported by this application release. Contact Flint support to repair the account setup configuration before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SETUP_REPAIR_REQUIRED: The merchant's account setup needs repair. Contact Flint support to repair the account setup before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE: The merchant's account setup is unavailable. Complete account setup or contact Flint support before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACH_TRANSACTION_PURPOSE_UNRESOLVED: ACH debit cannot be offered because the order's line items do not show whether the purchase is for goods or services. Include a physical or digital product line item, or use service products for every line item that is not a fee. Otherwise collect payment without ACH debit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: The resource's current state does not allow this action. Branch on details[0].reason; fall back to current_status for unknown reasons and use supported_actions when present.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_DEMO_SESSION_EXISTS: An active demo session already exists. Use the active demo session or end it before creating another.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_LINE_ITEM_SOURCE_CHANGE: An active payment link cannot add, remove, or change the key or catalog source of its line items. Keep every existing payment_link_line_item_id with its key, variant_id, and bundle_id, or set status to inactive before replacing line items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_OPTION_SELECTOR_COLLAPSE: The option replacement would make active variant selections indistinguishable. Keep enough active options and values to distinguish every active variant.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AFFIRM_REFUND_RETRY_NOT_ALLOWED: A failed provider refund already exists for this Affirm payment. Do not create a new provider refund. Use an alternative reimbursement and reconcile the failed Refund.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ALREADY_EXISTS: A resource already occupies the requested key or slot. Use details[0].current_resource, or choose another key or slot.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The manual payment is larger than the invoice's collectible balance. Retrieve the invoice and record an amount_money no greater than its collectible balance.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE: The refund amount is more than what remains refundable on the order, payment, line item, or charge. Reduce the amount named by param. For a line item or charge, details[0].maximum_money gives the remaining refundable amount and currency; otherwise read the order's settlement amounts. To refund the full remainder, set refund_type to full and remove amount_money, line_items, charges, tax_breakdown_refunds, and tender_allocations.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The payment processor's amount for this payment intent no longer matches Flint's record. Do not retry the confirmation. Contact support with the request_id and the payment intent ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_NOT_ADJUSTABLE: unit_price_overrides names a line item whose price buyers cannot change. Remove the line item from unit_price_overrides.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_ALREADY_REVOKED: The API key is already revoked. Retrieve the API key to confirm its status. Revocation is permanent; create a new key if you need an active credential.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_CHANGED: The API key changed before the update or revocation could be applied. Retrieve the API key, review its current state, and retry the action if it still applies.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_VERSION_RETIRED: The requested API version has retired. Set Flint-Version to a supported version listed in the error details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Authentication is required to complete this request. Complete the authentication described by the error message and next_actions before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_PAYOUT_NOT_CANCELABLE: An automatic payout cannot be canceled. Read the payout to check its status. Automatic payouts cannot be canceled through this operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_PROMOTIONS_DISABLED: Automatic promotions are turned off in the merchant's promotion settings. Set promotions.automatic_enabled to true with PATCH /v1/settings first, or stop turning on automatic promotions in the field identified by param.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_CONNECTION_REQUIRED: Automatic tax needs an active tax connection for the account. Connect automatic tax in the dashboard's tax settings, use external tax, or turn tax off.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_ORIGIN_ADDRESS_REQUIRED: A location the order ships or is picked up from has no country or postal code. Add a country and postal code to the location named in the message, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_UNAVAILABLE: Automatic tax is temporarily unavailable for this account. Use external tax for this order or contact Flint support.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BILLING_INTERVAL_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store doesn't offer other billing intervals for this subscription. Change it only when the subscription's billing_interval_options lists more than one option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_COMPONENT_PRODUCT_NOT_ACTIVE: A bundle component references a product that is not active. Use a variant whose parent product is active, or keep the bundle inactive.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_COMPONENT_VARIANT_NOT_ACTIVE: A bundle component references a variant that is not active. Use an active variant, or keep the bundle inactive.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_NOT_SELLABLE: The bundle is inactive or its component configuration cannot be sold. Choose an active, sellable bundle or correct its component configuration before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_IMMEDIATELY_NOT_ALLOWED: The store ends a buyer's cancellation when the billing period ends. Read buyer_actions.cancel.timing and omit cancel_immediately when timing is end_of_period.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPABILITIES_IMMUTABLE: The requested capabilities differ from the ones account setup already started with. Omit requested_capabilities, or send the same capabilities as the earlier request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPABILITY_NOT_REQUESTED: The operation needs a capability that has not been requested for this merchant account. Check readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant. For accept_ach_debit_payments, add ach_debit to the checkout or invoice payment options with PATCH /v1/settings. For other capabilities, contact Flint support.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPTURE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURABLE: The requested capture exceeds the authorization's current capturable amount. Use an amount no greater than capturable_money, or omit amount_money to capture the available authorization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_INVENTORY_RELATIONSHIP_INVALID: The catalog item's inventory configuration is inconsistent. Correct the catalog item's inventory relationship before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_LINE_ITEM_CURRENCY_CHANGED: The catalog item's currency no longer matches the order line item. Use a catalog item in the order's currency, or create a new order in the catalog item's current currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_LINE_ITEM_SOURCE_CHANGED: The order line item's catalog source no longer matches the current variant. Remove the line item and add the current variant to the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CREDENTIAL_CHANGED: Checkout authentication was rotated before payment work became durable. Refresh the checkout session through its owning invoice or checkout entry point, then resume the same payment attempt if it remains available.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CUSTOMER_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED: The checkout already acts for a customer, so it needs no code. Save or pay with that customer's cards without a code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CUSTOMER_CHANGED: The order's customer is not the customer this checkout session was created for. Create a new checkout session for the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_CURRENT_CHANGED: The session named by replace_checkout_session_id is no longer the order's current open session. Refresh the session identified by current_checkout_session_id and blocking_resources before retrying the replacement.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_EXPIRED: The checkout session closed, so it cannot be used for this request. Create a new checkout session for the order and continue through it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_MODIFIERS_READ_ONLY: This checkout session cannot modify line item modifiers. Inspect reason: existing_order_checkout uses the existing Order, invoice_finalized uses a finalized Invoice, and subscription_terms_locked uses locked subscription terms. Update the source resource when its state allows changes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_NOT_OPEN: The checkout session is no longer open. Read the session and choose an action its current status allows.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_SCOPE_MISMATCH: The checkout credential cannot use this mode or checkout session. Use the credential issued for this checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SPLIT_PAYMENT_UNSUPPORTED: Hosted checkout collects an order with one payment method, and the order has more than one unpaid payment leg. Cancel each leg in payment_intent_ids with POST /v1/payment-intents/{payment_intent_id}/cancel, then create the session again so hosted checkout collects the balance in one payment. To take a split payment, collect it in your own payment UI, for example under an embedded checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SURFACE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: A payment is in progress on this checkout, so its surface can't change. Finish or cancel the payment on existing_checkout_session_id, or request the session's current surface.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_TAX_CALCULATION_LIMIT_REACHED: The checkout session reached its tax calculation limit. Start a new checkout session or contact the merchant before calculating tax again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: The write lost internal contention while the caller's basis was still current. Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_ALREADY_USED: The confirmation token was already used for a different payment intent. Create a new confirmation token for this payment intent and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_EXPIRED: The confirmation token has expired. Create a new confirmation token and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.COUNTRY_IMMUTABLE: The country differs from the one account setup already started with. Omit country, or send the same country as the earlier request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_ALLOCATION_ALREADY_REVERSED: The credit note allocation was already reversed. Read the allocation to confirm its reversed_at value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The allocation exceeds an available balance. Allocate no more than the credit note's available_money and the invoice's outstanding amount. x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CREDITABLE: The correction exceeds the invoice line's remaining creditable value. Reduce the correction amount or quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_ISSUE_IN_PROGRESS: Another credit note is being issued for this merchant. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key after the current issue finishes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_NOT_DRAFT: Only draft credit notes can be changed. Create a new draft credit note for another correction.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_NOT_ISSUED: The credit note is not issued. Check current_status. Issue a draft before allocating it, refunding it, or downloading its PDF. Only issued notes can be voided, and void notes cannot be allocated or refunded.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_REFUND_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The refund exceeds the available credit. Use an amount no greater than the credit note available_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_ALREADY_APPROVED: The customer's deletion has already been approved. Retrieve the latest deletion request to check its status.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_BLOCKED: The customer still has subscriptions or saved payment methods that could remain operational after account deletion. Cancel every non-canceled subscription and remove every saved payment method, then retry approval.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_PROCESSING: The customer is being deleted or was deleted and can't be changed. Read the customer's status. Use a different active customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_REQUEST_NOT_PENDING: The deletion request's status does not allow this decision. Retrieve the deletion request. A failed request can only be approved again; repeat an applied decision only to retrieve its result.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_STATE_CHANGED: The customer changed while the deletion request was being resolved. Retrieve the deletion request and try again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_EMAIL_BUYER_MANAGED: this customer's email is their sign-in for your store's Flint-hosted account, so only the customer can change it Create a customer session for this customer with POST /v1/customer-sessions, then create the change with POST /v1/me/email-change-requests and the new email. The customer confirms it with the codes Flint emails them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_EMAIL_REQUIRED: The customer has no email address, so there are no email preferences to read or change. Add an email to the customer, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_TERM_UNAVAILABLE: The invoice has no customer default payment term to use. Attach a customer with a default invoice payment term, or choose another payment_due.type.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: The verification is already confirmed. Link the purchases with this verification.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: The verification has no confirmation attempts left. Request a new verification code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_EMAIL_CHANGED: The customer's email changed after verification. Request a code for the customer's current email.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED: The customer verification expired. Create a new customer verification and confirm its code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_LIMIT_REACHED: The checkout has requested as many codes of this channel as it can: 5 emailed codes, or 6 texted-code requests. After a texted-code request, send the code by email instead; otherwise continue without saved details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_CONFIRMED: The customer verification has not been confirmed. Confirm the Flint-sent code before linking guest purchases.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_OFFERED: This checkout does not offer saved payment details. Read the checkout session and request a code only when save_payment_method_requires_verification is true.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_SENT: Flint sent no code for a use_saved_payment_methods request with channel auto, the default: the email has no saved details at this merchant, a cap on codes was reached, or codes can't be sent right now. Show nothing about saved details, and let the buyer pay without them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE: Flint can't text a code for this checkout: the email has no details saved with a mobile phone number at this merchant, a cap on texts was reached, or texts can't be sent right now. Offer the emailed code instead, or continue without saved details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_USED: The customer verification was already redeemed. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key, or create and confirm a new verification.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED: The customer account hostname's payment method domain is not ready for Apple Pay and Google Pay in this environment. Flint registers the hostname as a payment method domain when you create the custom domain. Find it with GET /v1/payment-method-domains and read validation_status and payment_options: unavailable means Flint couldn't read a wallet's status, for example while the environment's payment account isn't ready, and action_required means the registration or one of its wallets isn't active. Contact support with the request_id if the error persists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Custom domains are not active for this account. Activate custom domains, then set the custom domain again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_UNAVAILABLE: The custom domain is in use by another account, as the other custom hostname, or in another environment. Use a different hostname, or remove it where it is set and then set it again. If another account used it, verify ownership after that account removes it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_ENVIRONMENT_REQUIRED: The merchant has no default live environment configured. Configure a default live merchant environment before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD_CONFLICT: The default payment method cannot be set and cleared in the same request. Send default_payment_method_id as a payment method ID to set it, or null to clear it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATIONS_MANAGED_EXTE: Another system manages the default payout destinations. Update the default destinations through the system that manages them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_INVALID: The default payout destination cannot receive this payout. Choose an eligible payout destination before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_REPLACEMENT_R: Removing this default payout destination requires a replacement. Choose another default payout destination before removing this one.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_REQUIRED: No default payout destination is configured. Configure a default payout destination before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_SANDBOX_CANNOT_BE_ARCHIVED: The default sandbox cannot be archived. The default sandbox cannot be archived. Use a separate sandbox for disposable test data.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_SANDBOX_CANNOT_BE_RESET: The default sandbox cannot be reset. Choose a sandbox that supports reset.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_CALCULATION_EXPIRED: The calculation behind the delivery selection expired before payment began. Create a new delivery quote, select a current option, and retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_COMMERCE_TREATMENT_UNSUPPORTED: The selected delivery obligations require incompatible commerce treatment. Change the delivery method or obligation configuration so the selected quantities share compatible tax, currency, and destination treatment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DEPENDENCY_REVOKED: A pinned delivery dependency was revoked and can no longer authorize a new quote or selection. Publish or select a replacement configuration revision, then create a new quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_CONTROLLED_BY_SELEC: The current delivery selection controls the order's delivery destination. Change or clear the delivery selection instead of updating delivery_destination directly.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_FROZEN: The order's delivery destination can no longer be changed. Read the current order and use fulfillment recipient corrections for execution changes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_ELIGIBILITY_CONTEXT_CHANGED: The delivery eligibility context changed. Request a new delivery quote and retry. Request a new delivery quote and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_REUSED: The delivery external reference is already bound to another selection. Reuse the existing selection or submit a new external reference.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_GROUPING_UNSUPPORTED: The delivery obligations cannot form a valid set of buyer choices. Change the assigned delivery profiles, origin policies, or splitting rules before creating another quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_OPTION_ALREADY_SELECTED: The selected delivery option belongs to another selection. Read the current selection, then retry with its ID as the compare-and-swap value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_OPTION_EXPIRED: The selected delivery option or its guarantee expired. Create a new delivery quote and select a current option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PICKUP_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED: The current delivery selection changed during the pickup search. Read the current delivery selection and retry with its ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PICKUP_LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: The requested pickup location is not available for the configured delivery methods. Choose a pickup location from the configured collection and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PREVIEW_REQUIRES_CHECKOUT: The requested preview depends on checkout-only state. Create or update a checkout session, then request a checkout delivery quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_BASIS_INVALID: The pending quote no longer matches the supplied checkout inputs. Create a new quote from the current checkout inputs.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_EXPIRED: The delivery quote or one of its options expired. Create a new delivery quote and select a current option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_INCOMPLETE: The delivery quote still requires caller input or rates. Supply every input or caller-supplied method result requested by the pending quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_INPUT_CHANGED: The selected destination conflicts with address facts used by the quote. Create a new delivery quote using the selected destination.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_REVOKED: The delivery quote was revoked. Create a new quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_STALE: The quote no longer matches the current checkout authority. Create a new delivery quote and retry the selection.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_RATE_CALLBACK_SECRET_ROTATION_O: The delivery rate callback's previous signing key is still valid from an earlier rotation. Retry after previous_key_expires_at. If the current key leaked, revoke it, then rotate.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_REQUOTE_REQUIRED: The delivery quote or selection must be replaced. Create a new delivery quote, select an option, and resend with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT: Another write changed the delivery resource while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the delivery resource again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_CHANGED: The current delivery selection changed after the request basis was read. Read the effective selection, create a replacement-basis quote, and retry with its exact selection ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_EXPIRED: The delivery selection expired before payment began. Create a new delivery quote, select a current option, and retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_NOT_MUTABLE_AFTER_PAY: The delivery selection can no longer be changed after payment begins. Read the current order and continue with its committed delivery selection.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_REPLACEMENT_LIMIT_REA: This checkout reached its protected delivery selection history limit. Finish or restart the checkout. Terminal private payloads become eligible for redaction after their retention period.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_STATE_CONFLICT: The delivery resource is not in a state that allows the operation. Read the current resource and choose an operation valid for its lifecycle state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_UPDATE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store does not allow buyers to change subscription delivery. Ask the store to update the preference or enable customer_account.buyer_capabilities.can_update_delivery.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_WINDOW_EXPIRED: The selected delivery window expired. Create a new delivery quote and select a current window.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEMO_SESSION_NOT_CURRENT: demo_session_id is not this client's current demo session. Send the current session's demo_session_id, which ACTIVE_DEMO_SESSION_EXISTS returns, or create a demo session when none is active.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEMO_SESSION_SECRET_REPLAY_EXPIRED: The demo session secret is no longer available for replay. Create a new demo session to obtain a new secret.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEVICE_ARCHIVED: The device is archived and cannot be changed. Use the ID of an active device.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEVICE_LOCATION_MISMATCH: The device does not belong to the given location. Send a device_id assigned to location_id, or change location_id to the device's location.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DISCOUNT_NOT_REMOVABLE: The discount comes from an automatic promotion, which applies while the order qualifies. Make the promotion inactive to stop applying it. Merchant discounts and code discounts can still be removed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_CODE: Another resource already uses this code. Use the existing resource or send a different code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_ALREADY_LINKED: The email address is already linked. Use the linked account or choose another email address.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_CHANGE_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: The email change was already confirmed. Sign the buyer in again with the new email.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_CHANGE_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: The email change has no confirmation attempts left. Request a new email change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_CHANGE_CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED: The email change confirmation window expired. Request a new email change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_CHANGE_SUPERSEDED: A newer email change replaced this request. Use the codes from the latest email change request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EMAIL_PREFERENCE_LINK_INVALID: The email preference link is invalid or belongs to another merchant environment. Use the token from the buyer's latest email with the merchant key for that environment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EVENT_SOLD_OUT: The event has no tickets left. Stop offering the event, or raise event_config.max_total_quantity on the payment link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EVENT_TICKETS_INSUFFICIENT: The event has fewer tickets left than this order requests. Request no more than available_quantity tickets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_PAID_ORDER_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED: The billing account reached its monthly limit for externally recorded paid orders. Request a higher allowance from Flint, or record the payment after the monthly limit resets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR: A required external service failed. Retry the same request with exponential backoff and jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FILE_NOT_UPLOADED: The file bytes have not arrived. PUT the bytes to upload.url before upload.expires_at, then complete the file.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FLAT_TAX_PAYMENT_ATTRIBUTION_UNAVAILABLE: The flat tax is not fully attributable to refundable payment settlements. For a flat tax split across payments, refund by order_id instead of payment_intent_id. Otherwise, check the order's remaining refundable tax and payment amounts.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FLAT_TAX_REFUND_STATE_INVALID: Stored flat-tax refund lineage is inconsistent with whole-or-nothing reversal. Contact support with the request ID so Flint can repair the order's refund records
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FORBIDDEN: The credential does not permit this request. Use a credential authorized for this operation. Read details[0].reason.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_ACTIVE_SHIPMENT_EXECUTION: A shipment fulfillment cannot release its quantity while it has a shipment that is not voided. Void the fulfillment's shipments first, or fail it with release_quantity set to false.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This fulfillment requires explicit merchant approval before work begins. Accept the fulfillment, then advance it into preparation, movement, or completion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_CHANGED: Another write changed the fulfillment while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the fulfillment again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETED: The fulfillment is completed. Read the fulfillment and choose an action its status allows.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETED_DETAILS_REPLACEMEN: A completed fulfillment cannot replace these details. Keep the completed fulfillment details and create another fulfillment if needed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETION_TIMESTAMP_REQUIRE: Completion timestamps can be recorded only on a completed fulfillment. Complete the fulfillment with the complete action, then correct its completion timestamp with PATCH if needed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_CONFIGURATION_ACTION_REQUIRE: The catalog item has no active fulfillment profile with a usable revision. Assign an active fulfillment profile with a usable current revision to the catalog item before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_EVENT_DEDUPE_CONFLICT: An event with this external_system and external_event_id already exists with different details. Resend the original event unchanged, or use a new external_event_id for a different event.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_EVENT_SUBJECT_INVALID: Flint could not resolve the fulfillment event's subject. Contact support with the request_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_INACTIVE: The fulfillment is canceled, failed, or marked no-show, so it cannot take this change. Use an active fulfillment, or create a new fulfillment for the items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_METHOD_ASSIGNMENT_UNSATISFIA: The assigned delivery methods cannot fulfill every item that requires delivery. Assign, for each item, a method whose type is in the item's delivery profile allowed_types: in delivery_method_ids on the checkout session or payment link, or in settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids, which payment links without methods and invoice checkouts use.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE: A delivery method in the request, a checkout, a payment link, or the checkout default, or a zone, location set, or rate callback it uses, is missing or not active. Use IDs of active delivery methods whose zones, location sets, and rate callbacks are active. When present, blocking_resources names the resource to replace or activate.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_PROFILE_REVISION_UNUSABLE: The fulfillment profile revision cannot fulfill this catalog item. Correct the fulfillment profile revision described in the error response before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE: The delivery profile is not available. Use an active delivery profile in the same environment, or omit delivery_profile_id when the catalog default applies.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE: A fulfillment line item quantity is more than the quantity left to fulfill. Send a quantity no greater than the line item's unfulfilled quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_LINE_ITEM: The line item quantity would be less than the quantity in its active fulfillments. Keep quantity at or above the quantity in active fulfillments, or cancel those fulfillments first.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: This checkout requires a delivery selection before payment can begin. Create a current delivery quote, select one option for every choice group, then retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SHIPMENT_NOT_VOIDABLE: The shipment is past the packed stage and cannot be voided. Void a shipment only while it is created or packed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_STATUS_CONFLICT: The fulfillment, shipment, or package changed while this request was being saved. Read the current resource and retry the change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_ALLOCATION_CHANGED: The gift card authorization or allocation changed before payment. Refresh the order, apply the current code when required, and accept the new allocation before payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_BUYER_EMAIL_REQUIRED: gift card purchases need the buyer's email for purchase limits Use a customer that has an email, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED: A gift card challenge is required after repeated failed codes. Show the challenge from remediation.next_actions to the buyer, then retry the same request with its proof in Flint-Gift-Card-Challenge. If there is no next action, launch the checkout session with page_origin.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_FUNDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The requested gift card funding exceeds a funding or balance limit. Send a smaller amount, wait for the limit to reset at the reported time, or split the value across cards.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_INSUFFICIENT_VALUE: The gift card has insufficient available value for the requested allocation. Refresh the balance and accept a new allocation before payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_CONFLICT: The gift card purchase cannot be funded under its original terms or funding limits. Keep the original buyer and offer, resolve any existing payment attempt, and check the buyer funding limit before starting another payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The gift card purchase exceeds a daily purchase limit. Wait until the next UTC day before starting a new purchase attempt.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_REFUND_CONFLICT: The original gift card purchase value is unavailable for this cash refund. Check the original funding load and pending refunds. Refund only eligible unspent value and resolve any reserved or spent value before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_REFUND_DESTINATION_REQUIRED: The original gift card cannot accept the full refund within its lifecycle and balance cap. Set destination new_gift_card for that gift card allocation and retry with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_STATE_CONFLICT: The gift card operation conflicts with a lifecycle or provenance constraint. Retrieve the current resource and resolve its stated constraint before submitting a new operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_PROGRESS: A request with the same idempotency key is still in progress. Retry with the same idempotency key using exponential backoff with jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: The idempotency key was reused with a different request body. Use the original request body with this idempotency key, or generate a new idempotency key for a new operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Flint cannot safely recover the original operation's outcome. Read the resource or list the route's results to confirm whether the original operation took effect. Do not switch keys or resend as a new operation until you have confirmed it had no effect. Contact support with the request_id if the outcome cannot be determined.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: fresh identity verification is required Verify your identity again and obtain a new session token, then retry the original request. Keep the same Idempotency-Key if one was sent.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_ASSET_NOT_ATTACHABLE: The image is incomplete, expired, or no longer attachable. Complete the file, or upload a new one if it expired; GET /v1/files/{file_id} shows which. For a Flint url past its reuse window, send the original source_url.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_EXPIRED: The prior image ingestion expired and its reserved storage was cleaned up. Retry the request with a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_IN_PROGRESS: The same image ingestion step is still running. Retry with the same idempotency key and request body using exponential backoff with jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_RESTART_REQUIRED: The prior image ingestion attempt ended and cannot be resumed. Wait briefly for cleanup, then start a new ingestion with a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_NOT_ATTACHABLE: The image cannot be attached to this resource. Use an attachable image returned for the same merchant and environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_OWNER_NOT_MUTABLE: The resource no longer accepts image changes. Retrieve the resource and update images only while the resource is mutable.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_PROCESSING_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: Image processing capacity is temporarily exhausted. Retry with exponential backoff. If remediation says to start a new ingestion, use a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_PROCESSING_FAILED: The image could not be decoded or processed safely. Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key. If the ingestion requires a restart, follow the reason-specific remediation.
